metadata.english_translation: The wise person is superior to the ascetic, the scholar, and the man of action; therefore, be thou a wise person, O Arjuna!
metadata.sanskrit_text: तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः। कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन।।6.46।।

document:
Chapter: Dhyana Yoga
Meaning: Path of Meditation
Translation: I look upon him as the best of mystics, who, full of faith, worships Me and abides in Me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of Meditation
metadata.english_translation: I look upon him as the best of mystics, who, full of faith, worships Me and abides in Me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: योगिनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना। श्रद्धावान्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः।।6.47।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: Lord Shri Krishna said: Listen, O Arjuna! I will tell you how you can know Me in my full perfection. Practice meditation with your mind devoted to Me and take Me as your refuge.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna said: Listen, O Arjuna! I will tell you how you can know Me in my full perfection. Practice meditation with your mind devoted to Me and take Me as your refuge.
metadata.sanskrit_text: श्री भगवानुवाच मय्यासक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः। असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु।।7.1।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: I will reveal this knowledge to you and how it can be realized; once accomplished, there is nothing else worth having in this life.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: I will reveal this knowledge to you and how it can be realized; once accomplished, there is nothing else worth having in this life.
metadata.sanskrit_text: ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः। यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते।।7.2।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: Among thousands of men, scarcely one strives for perfection, and even among those who gain occult powers, perhaps only one knows me in truth.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: Among thousands of men, scarcely one strives for perfection, and even among those who gain occult powers, perhaps only one knows me in truth.
metadata.sanskrit_text: मनुष्याणां सहस्रेषु कश्िचद्यतति सिद्धये। यततामपि सिद्धानां कश्िचन्मां वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।।7.3।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: Earth, water, fire, air, ether, mind, intellect, and personality—this is the eightfold division of My manifested nature.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: Earth, water, fire, air, ether, mind, intellect, and personality—this is the eightfold division of My manifested nature.
metadata.sanskrit_text: भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च। अहङ्कार इतीयं मे भिन्ना प्रकृतिरष्टधा।।7.4।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: This is My inferior nature; however, O valiant one, know that distinct from this is My superior nature, which is the very life that sustains the universe.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: This is My inferior nature; however, O valiant one, know that distinct from this is My superior nature, which is the very life that sustains the universe.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अपरेयमितस्त्वन्यां प्रकृतिं विद्धि मे पराम्। जीवभूतां महाबाहो ययेदं धार्यते जगत्।।7.5।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: It is the womb of all beings; for I am He by Whom the worlds were created and shall be dissolved.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: It is the womb of all beings; for I am He by Whom the worlds were created and shall be dissolved.
metadata.sanskrit_text: एतद्योनीनि भूतानि सर्वाणीत्युपधारय। अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा।।7.6।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: O Arjuna! There is nothing higher than Me; all is strung on Me like rows of pearls on a thread.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: O Arjuna! There is nothing higher than Me; all is strung on Me like rows of pearls on a thread.
metadata.sanskrit_text: मत्तः परतरं नान्यत्किञ्चिदस्ति धनञ्जय। मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव।।7.7।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: O Arjuna! I am the fluidity in water, the light in the sun and moon, the mystic syllable Om in the Vedic scriptures, the sound in ether, and the virility in man.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: O Arjuna! I am the fluidity in water, the light in the sun and moon, the mystic syllable Om in the Vedic scriptures, the sound in ether, and the virility in man.
metadata.sanskrit_text: रसोऽहमप्सु कौन्तेय प्रभास्मि शशिसूर्ययोः। प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु।।7.8।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: I am the fragrance of the earth, the brilliance of fire, the life force in all beings, and the austerity of ascetics.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: I am the fragrance of the earth, the brilliance of fire, the life force in all beings, and the austerity of ascetics.
metadata.sanskrit_text: पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ। जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चास्मि तपस्विषु।।7.9।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: Know, O Arjuna, that I am the eternal seed of being; I am the intelligence of the intelligent, the splendour of the resplendent.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: Know, O Arjuna, that I am the eternal seed of being; I am the intelligence of the intelligent, the splendour of the resplendent.
metadata.sanskrit_text: बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम्। बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्।।7.10।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: I am the strength of the strong, those who are free from attachment and desire; and, O Arjuna, I am the desire for righteousness.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: I am the strength of the strong, those who are free from attachment and desire; and, O Arjuna, I am the desire for righteousness.
metadata.sanskrit_text: बलं बलवतां चाहं कामरागविवर्जितम्। धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि भरतर्षभ।।7.11।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: Whatever be the nature of their life, whether it be pure, passionate, or ignorant, they are all derived from Me. They are in Me, but I am not in them.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: Whatever be the nature of their life, whether it be pure, passionate, or ignorant, they are all derived from Me. They are in Me, but I am not in them.
metadata.sanskrit_text: ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये। मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि नत्वहं तेषु ते मयि।।7.12।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: The inhabitants of the world, misled by the natures engendered by the Qualities, do not know that I am higher than them all and that I do not change.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: The inhabitants of the world, misled by the natures engendered by the Qualities, do not know that I am higher than them all and that I do not change.
metadata.sanskrit_text: त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत्। मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम्।।7.13।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: Verily, this divine illusion of phenomenon manifesting itself in the qualities is difficult to surmount. Only they who devote themselves exclusively to Me can accomplish it.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: Verily, this divine illusion of phenomenon manifesting itself in the qualities is difficult to surmount. Only they who devote themselves exclusively to Me can accomplish it.
metadata.sanskrit_text: दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया। मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते।।7.14।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: The sinner, the ignorant, the vile, deprived of spiritual perception by the glamour of illusion, and he who leads a godless life—none of them shall find me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: The sinner, the ignorant, the vile, deprived of spiritual perception by the glamour of illusion, and he who leads a godless life—none of them shall find me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः। माययापहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः।।7.15।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: O Arjuna! The righteous who worship Me are grouped in stages: first, those who suffer, next those who desire knowledge, then those who thirst after truth, and lastly those who attain wisdom.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: O Arjuna! The righteous who worship Me are grouped in stages: first, those who suffer, next those who desire knowledge, then those who thirst after truth, and lastly those who attain wisdom.
metadata.sanskrit_text: चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनोऽर्जुन। आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च भरतर्षभ।।7.16।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: Of all these, he who has gained wisdom, who meditates on Me without ceasing, devoting himself solely to Me, is the best; for I am exceedingly beloved by the wise man, and the wise man is also beloved by Me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: Of all these, he who has gained wisdom, who meditates on Me without ceasing, devoting himself solely to Me, is the best; for I am exceedingly beloved by the wise man, and the wise man is also beloved by Me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्ितर्विशिष्यते। प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः।।7.17।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: Noble-minded are they all, but the wise man I hold as my own self; for he, remaining always at peace with me, makes me his ultimate goal.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: Noble-minded are they all, but the wise man I hold as my own self; for he, remaining always at peace with me, makes me his ultimate goal.
metadata.sanskrit_text: उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम्। आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम्।।7.18।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: After many lives, at last the wise one realizes Me as I am. It is very difficult to find a man so enlightened that he sees God everywhere.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: After many lives, at last the wise one realizes Me as I am. It is very difficult to find a man so enlightened that he sees God everywhere.
metadata.sanskrit_text: बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान्मां प्रपद्यते। वासुदेवः सर्वमिति स महात्मा सुदुर्लभः।।7.19।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: They in whom wisdom is obscured by one desire or another, worship the lesser powers, practicing many rites that vary according to their temperaments.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: They in whom wisdom is obscured by one desire or another, worship the lesser powers, practicing many rites that vary according to their temperaments.
metadata.sanskrit_text: कामैस्तैस्तैर्हृतज्ञानाः प्रपद्यन्तेऽन्यदेवताः। तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया।।7.20।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: But whatever form of worship, if the devotee has faith, then I set My own seal upon their faith in that worship.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: But whatever form of worship, if the devotee has faith, then I set My own seal upon their faith in that worship.
metadata.sanskrit_text: यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति। तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहम्।।7.21।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: If he worships one form alone with real faith, then his desires shall be fulfilled through that alone; for thus I have ordained.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: If he worships one form alone with real faith, then his desires shall be fulfilled through that alone; for thus I have ordained.
metadata.sanskrit_text: स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते। लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान् हि तान्।।7.22।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: The fruit that comes to people of limited insight is, after all, finite. Those who worship the Lower Powers attain them; but those who worship Me come to Me alone.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: The fruit that comes to people of limited insight is, after all, finite. Those who worship the Lower Powers attain them; but those who worship Me come to Me alone.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम्। देवान्देवयजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति मामपि।।7.23।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: The ignorant think of Me, who am the Unmanifested Spirit, as if I were in human form. They do not understand that My Superior Nature is unchanging and most excellent.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: The ignorant think of Me, who am the Unmanifested Spirit, as if I were in human form. They do not understand that My Superior Nature is unchanging and most excellent.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अव्यक्तं व्यक्ितमापन्नं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः। परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम्।।7.24।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: I am not visible to all, for I am enveloped by the illusion of the Phenomenon. This deluded world does not know Me as the Unborn and Imperishable.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: I am not visible to all, for I am enveloped by the illusion of the Phenomenon. This deluded world does not know Me as the Unborn and Imperishable.
metadata.sanskrit_text: नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः। मूढोऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको मामजमव्ययम्।।7.25।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: I know, O Arjuna, all beings in the past, the present, and the future; but they do not know Me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: I know, O Arjuna, all beings in the past, the present, and the future; but they do not know Me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: वेदाहं समतीतानि वर्तमानानि चार्जुन। भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन।।7.26।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: O brave Arjuna! Man lives in a fantastical world, deceived by the glamour of opposing sensations, infatuated by desire and aversion.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: O brave Arjuna! Man lives in a fantastical world, deceived by the glamour of opposing sensations, infatuated by desire and aversion.
metadata.sanskrit_text: इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत। सर्वभूतानि संमोहं सर्गे यान्ति परन्तप।।7.27।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: But those who act righteously, in whom sin has been destroyed, who are free from the infatuation of conflicting emotions, they worship Me with a firm resolve.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: But those who act righteously, in whom sin has been destroyed, who are free from the infatuation of conflicting emotions, they worship Me with a firm resolve.
metadata.sanskrit_text: येषां त्वन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम्। ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढव्रताः।।7.28।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: Those who make Me their refuge, striving for liberation from decay and death, realize the Supreme Spirit, which is their own real Self, and in which all action finds its consummation.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: Those who make Me their refuge, striving for liberation from decay and death, realize the Supreme Spirit, which is their own real Self, and in which all action finds its consummation.
metadata.sanskrit_text: जरामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति ये। ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम्।।7.29।।

document:
Chapter: Gyaan Vigyana Yoga
Meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
Translation: Those who see Me in the life of the world, in the universal sacrifice, and as pure Divinity, keeping their minds steady, they live in Me even in the hour of death's approach.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Self-Knowledge and Enlightenment
metadata.english_translation: Those who see Me in the life of the world, in the universal sacrifice, and as pure Divinity, keeping their minds steady, they live in Me even in the hour of death's approach.
metadata.sanskrit_text: साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः। प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः।।7.30।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: Arjuna asked: O Lord of Lords! What is that which people call the Supreme Spirit, what is humanity's spiritual nature, and what is the law? What is matter and what is divinity?

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: Arjuna asked: O Lord of Lords! What is that which people call the Supreme Spirit, what is humanity's spiritual nature, and what is the law? What is matter and what is divinity?
metadata.sanskrit_text: अर्जुन उवाच किं तद्ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम। अधिभूतं च किं प्रोक्तमधिदैवं किमुच्यते।।8.1।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: Who rules the spirit sacrifice in many, and how may those who have learned self-control come to the knowledge of Thee at the time of death?

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: Who rules the spirit sacrifice in many, and how may those who have learned self-control come to the knowledge of Thee at the time of death?
metadata.sanskrit_text: अधियज्ञः कथं कोऽत्र देहेऽस्मिन्मधुसूदन। प्रयाणकाले च कथं ज्ञेयोऽसि नियतात्मभिः।।8.2।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: The Lord Shri Krishna replied: The Supreme Spirit is the Highest Imperishable Self, and Its nature is spiritual consciousness. The worlds have been created and are sustained by an emanation from the Spirit, which is called the Law.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: The Lord Shri Krishna replied: The Supreme Spirit is the Highest Imperishable Self, and Its nature is spiritual consciousness. The worlds have been created and are sustained by an emanation from the Spirit, which is called the Law.
metadata.sanskrit_text: श्री भगवानुवाच अक्षरं ब्रह्म परमं स्वभावोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते। भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गः कर्मसंज्ञितः।।8.3।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: Matter consists of forms that perish; Divinity is the Supreme Self; and He who inspires the spirit of sacrifice in man, O noblest of their race, is I Myself, Who now stand in human form before thee.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: Matter consists of forms that perish; Divinity is the Supreme Self; and He who inspires the spirit of sacrifice in man, O noblest of their race, is I Myself, Who now stand in human form before thee.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अधिभूतं क्षरो भावः पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम्। अधियज्ञोऽहमेवात्र देहे देहभृतां वर।।8.4।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: Whosoever, at the time of death, thinks only of Me and, thinking thus, leaves the body and goes forth, will assuredly know Me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: Whosoever, at the time of death, thinks only of Me and, thinking thus, leaves the body and goes forth, will assuredly know Me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम्। यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः।।8.5।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: Whatever sphere of being the mind of a man is intent on at the time of death, to that he will go.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: Whatever sphere of being the mind of a man is intent on at the time of death, to that he will go.
metadata.sanskrit_text: यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम्। तं तमेवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः।।8.6।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: Therefore, always meditate on Me and fight; if your mind and reason are fixed on Me, you will surely come to Me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: Therefore, always meditate on Me and fight; if your mind and reason are fixed on Me, you will surely come to Me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च। मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयम्।।8.7।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: He whose mind does not wander, and who is engaged in constant meditation, attains the Supreme Spirit.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: He whose mind does not wander, and who is engaged in constant meditation, attains the Supreme Spirit.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना। परमं पुरुषं दिव्यं याति पार्थानुचिन्तयन्।।8.8।।

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: Whoso meditates on the Omniscient, the Ancient, more minute than an atom, yet the Ruler and Upholder of all, Unimaginable, Brilliant like the Sun, Beyond the reach of darkness;
metadata.sanskrit_text: कविं पुराणमनुशासितार मणोरणीयांसमनुस्मरेद्यः। सर्वस्य धातारमचिन्त्यरूप मादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात्।।8.9।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: He who leaves the body with an unmoved mind, filled with devotion, and by the power of his meditation gathers his whole vital energy between his eyebrows, attains the Supreme.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: He who leaves the body with an unmoved mind, filled with devotion, and by the power of his meditation gathers his whole vital energy between his eyebrows, attains the Supreme.
metadata.sanskrit_text: प्रयाणकाले मनसाऽचलेन भक्त्या युक्तो योगबलेन चैव। भ्रुवोर्मध्ये प्राणमावेश्य सम्यक् स तं परं पुरुषमुपैति दिव्यम्।।8.10।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: Now, I will briefly speak of the imperishable goal, proclaimed by those who are versed in the scriptures, which the mystic attains when free from passion, and for which they are content to undergo the vow of continence.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: Now, I will briefly speak of the imperishable goal, proclaimed by those who are versed in the scriptures, which the mystic attains when free from passion, and for which they are content to undergo the vow of continence.
metadata.sanskrit_text: यदक्षरं वेदविदो वदन्ति विशन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः। यदिच्छन्तो ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्ति तत्ते पदं संग्रहेण प्रवक्ष्ये।।8.11।।

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: Closing the gates of the body, drawing the forces of his mind into the heart, and, by the power of meditation, concentrating his vital energy in the brain;
metadata.sanskrit_text: सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च। मूर्ध्न्याधायात्मनः प्राणमास्थितो योगधारणाम्।।8.12।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: Repeating Om, the symbol of eternity, and holding Me always in remembrance, he who thus leaves his body and goes forth reaches the Supreme Spirit.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: Repeating Om, the symbol of eternity, and holding Me always in remembrance, he who thus leaves his body and goes forth reaches the Supreme Spirit.
metadata.sanskrit_text: ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन्मामनुस्मरन्। यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम्।।8.13।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: To him who constantly thinks of Me and nothing else, to such an ever-faithful devotee, O Arjuna, I am ever accessible.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: To him who constantly thinks of Me and nothing else, to such an ever-faithful devotee, O Arjuna, I am ever accessible.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः। तस्याहं सुलभः पार्थ नित्ययुक्तस्य योगिनः।।8.14।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: Coming to Me in this way, these great souls no longer go to the misery and death of earthly life, for they have achieved perfection.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: Coming to Me in this way, these great souls no longer go to the misery and death of earthly life, for they have achieved perfection.
metadata.sanskrit_text: मामुपेत्य पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयमशाश्वतम्। नाप्नुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिद्धिं परमां गताः।।8.15।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: The worlds, along with the entire realm of creation, come and go; but, O Arjuna, whoever comes to Me, for them there is no rebirth.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: The worlds, along with the entire realm of creation, come and go; but, O Arjuna, whoever comes to Me, for them there is no rebirth.
metadata.sanskrit_text: आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः पुनरावर्तिनोऽर्जुन। मामुपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते।।8.16।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: Those who understand the cosmic day and night know that one day of creation is a thousand cycles, and that the night is of equal length.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: Those who understand the cosmic day and night know that one day of creation is a thousand cycles, and that the night is of equal length.
metadata.sanskrit_text: सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तमहर्यद्ब्रह्मणो विदुः। रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां तेऽहोरात्रविदो जनाः।।8.17।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: At the dawn of that day, all objects in manifestation stream forth from the Unmanifest, and when evening falls, they are dissolved back into it again.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: At the dawn of that day, all objects in manifestation stream forth from the Unmanifest, and when evening falls, they are dissolved back into it again.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अव्यक्ताद्व्यक्तयः सर्वाः प्रभवन्त्यहरागमे। रात्र्यागमे प्रलीयन्ते तत्रैवाव्यक्तसंज्ञके।।8.18।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: The same multitude of beings, which have lived on earth so often, all are dissolved as the night of the universe approaches, to issue forth anew when morning breaks. Thus, it is ordained.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: The same multitude of beings, which have lived on earth so often, all are dissolved as the night of the universe approaches, to issue forth anew when morning breaks. Thus, it is ordained.
metadata.sanskrit_text: भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते। रात्र्यागमेऽवशः पार्थ प्रभवत्यहरागमे।।8.19।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: In truth, therefore, there is the eternal, unmanifest, which is beyond and above the unmanifest spirit of creation, and which is never destroyed when all these beings perish.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: In truth, therefore, there is the eternal, unmanifest, which is beyond and above the unmanifest spirit of creation, and which is never destroyed when all these beings perish.
metadata.sanskrit_text: परस्तस्मात्तु भावोऽन्योऽव्यक्तोऽव्यक्तात्सनातनः। यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति।।8.20।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: The wise say that the Unmanifest and Indestructible is the highest goal of all; when once that is reached, there is no returning. That is my blessed home.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: The wise say that the Unmanifest and Indestructible is the highest goal of all; when once that is reached, there is no returning. That is my blessed home.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अव्यक्तोऽक्षर इत्युक्तस्तमाहुः परमां गतिम्। यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम।।8.21।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: O Arjuna! That Highest God, in Whom all beings abide, and Who pervades the entire universe, is reached only by wholehearted devotion. *He is the one who determines the course of worldly events and the destiny of all living beings.*

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: O Arjuna! That Highest God, in Whom all beings abide, and Who pervades the entire universe, is reached only by wholehearted devotion. *He is the one who determines the course of worldly events and the destiny of all living beings.*
metadata.sanskrit_text: पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया। यस्यान्तःस्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम्।।8.22।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: Now, I will tell you, O Arjuna, the times at which, if the mystics go forth, they do not return, and at which they go forth only to return.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: Now, I will tell you, O Arjuna, the times at which, if the mystics go forth, they do not return, and at which they go forth only to return.
metadata.sanskrit_text: यत्र काले त्वनावृत्तिमावृत्तिं चैव योगिनः। प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ।।8.23।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: If the sage, knowing the Supreme Spirit, goes forth with fire and light during the day, in the fortnight of the waxing moon, and in the six months before the Northern summer solstice, he will attain the Supreme.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: If the sage, knowing the Supreme Spirit, goes forth with fire and light during the day, in the fortnight of the waxing moon, and in the six months before the Northern summer solstice, he will attain the Supreme.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अग्निर्ज्योतिरहः शुक्लः षण्मासा उत्तरायणम्। तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः।।8.24।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: But if he departs in gloom, at night, during the fortnight of the waning moon and in the six months before the winter solstice, then he reaches only lunar light and he will be reborn.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: But if he departs in gloom, at night, during the fortnight of the waning moon and in the six months before the winter solstice, then he reaches only lunar light and he will be reborn.
metadata.sanskrit_text: धूमो रात्रिस्तथा कृष्णः षण्मासा दक्षिणायनम्। तत्र चान्द्रमसं ज्योतिर्योगी प्राप्य निवर्तते।।8.25।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: These bright and dark paths out of the world have always existed. Whoever takes the former, does not return; he who chooses the latter, returns.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: These bright and dark paths out of the world have always existed. Whoever takes the former, does not return; he who chooses the latter, returns.
metadata.sanskrit_text: शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते। एकया यात्यनावृत्तिमन्ययाऽऽवर्तते पुनः।।8.26।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: O Arjuna! The saint, knowing these paths, is not confused; therefore, meditate perpetually.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: O Arjuna! The saint, knowing these paths, is not confused; therefore, meditate perpetually.
metadata.sanskrit_text: नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन। तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु योगयुक्तो भवार्जुन।।8.27।।

document:
Chapter: Akshara Brahma Yoga
Meaning: Path of the Eternal God
Translation: The sage who knows this passes beyond all merit that comes from the study of the scriptures, from sacrifice, from austerities, and from charity, and reaches the Supreme Primeval Abode.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Path of the Eternal God
metadata.english_translation: The sage who knows this passes beyond all merit that comes from the study of the scriptures, from sacrifice, from austerities, and from charity, and reaches the Supreme Primeval Abode.
metadata.sanskrit_text: वेदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैव दानेषु यत्पुण्यफलं प्रदिष्टम्। अत्येति तत्सर्वमिदं विदित्वा योगी परं स्थानमुपैति चाद्यम्।।8.28।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: Lord Shri Krishna said: I will now reveal to you, since you do not doubt, that profound mysticism, which, when followed with experience, will liberate you from sin.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna said: I will now reveal to you, since you do not doubt, that profound mysticism, which, when followed with experience, will liberate you from sin.
metadata.sanskrit_text: श्री भगवानुवाच इदं तु ते गुह्यतमं प्रवक्ष्याम्यनसूयवे। ज्ञानं विज्ञानसहितं यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात्।।9.1।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: This is the supreme science, the supreme secret, the purest and best; it is intuitive, righteous, and to those who practice it, it is exceedingly pleasant.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: This is the supreme science, the supreme secret, the purest and best; it is intuitive, righteous, and to those who practice it, it is exceedingly pleasant.
metadata.sanskrit_text: राजविद्या राजगुह्यं पवित्रमिदमुत्तमम्। प्रत्यक्षावगमं धर्म्यं सुसुखं कर्तुमव्ययम्।।9.2।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: They who have no faith in this teaching cannot find Me; they remain lost in the purlieus of this perishable world.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: They who have no faith in this teaching cannot find Me; they remain lost in the purlieus of this perishable world.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा धर्मस्यास्य परन्तप। अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवर्त्मनि।।9.3।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: The whole world is pervaded by Me, yet My form is not visible. All living beings have their being in Me, yet I am not confined by them.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: The whole world is pervaded by Me, yet My form is not visible. All living beings have their being in Me, yet I am not confined by them.
metadata.sanskrit_text: मया ततमिदं सर्वं जगदव्यक्तमूर्तिना। मत्स्थानि सर्वभूतानि न चाहं तेष्ववस्थितः।।9.4।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: Nevertheless, they do not consciously abide in Me. Such is My Divine Sovereignty that, though I, the Supreme Self, am the cause and upholder of all, yet I remain outside.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: Nevertheless, they do not consciously abide in Me. Such is My Divine Sovereignty that, though I, the Supreme Self, am the cause and upholder of all, yet I remain outside.
metadata.sanskrit_text: न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्। भूतभृन्न च भूतस्थो ममात्मा भूतभावनः।।9.5।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: As the mighty wind, though moving everywhere, has no resting place except in space, so all these beings have no home except in Me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: As the mighty wind, though moving everywhere, has no resting place except in space, so all these beings have no home except in Me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: यथाऽऽकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान्। तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीत्युपधारय।।9.6।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: All beings, O Arjuna, return at the end of every cosmic cycle into the realm of Nature, which is a part of Me, and at the start of the next I send them forth again.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: All beings, O Arjuna, return at the end of every cosmic cycle into the realm of Nature, which is a part of Me, and at the start of the next I send them forth again.
metadata.sanskrit_text: सर्वभूतानि कौन्तेय प्रकृतिं यान्ति मामिकाम्। कल्पक्षये पुनस्तानि कल्पादौ विसृजाम्यहम्।।9.7।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: With the help of Nature, I again and again pour forth the whole multitude of beings, whether they will or not, for they are ruled by My will.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: With the help of Nature, I again and again pour forth the whole multitude of beings, whether they will or not, for they are ruled by My will.
metadata.sanskrit_text: प्रकृतिं स्वामवष्टभ्य विसृजामि पुनः पुनः। भूतग्राममिमं कृत्स्नमवशं प्रकृतेर्वशात्।।9.8।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: But these acts of mine do not bind me; I remain outside and unattached.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: But these acts of mine do not bind me; I remain outside and unattached.
metadata.sanskrit_text: न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय। उदासीनवदासीनमसक्तं तेषु कर्मसु।।9.9।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: Under my guidance, Nature produces all movable and immovable things. Thus, O Arjuna, this universe revolves.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: Under my guidance, Nature produces all movable and immovable things. Thus, O Arjuna, this universe revolves.
metadata.sanskrit_text: मयाऽध्यक्षेण प्रकृतिः सूयते सचराचरम्। हेतुनाऽनेन कौन्तेय जगद्विपरिवर्तते।।9.10।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: Fools disregard Me, seeing Me clad in human form. They do not know that in My higher nature, I am the Lord-God of all.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: Fools disregard Me, seeing Me clad in human form. They do not know that in My higher nature, I am the Lord-God of all.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अवजानन्ति मां मूढा मानुषीं तनुमाश्रितम्। परं भावमजानन्तो मम भूतमहेश्वरम्।।9.11।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: Their hopes are futile, their actions worthless, their knowledge ineffective; they are without sense, deceitful, barbaric, and godless.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: Their hopes are futile, their actions worthless, their knowledge ineffective; they are without sense, deceitful, barbaric, and godless.
metadata.sanskrit_text: मोघाशा मोघकर्माणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतसः। राक्षसीमासुरीं चैव प्रकृतिं मोहिनीं श्रिताः।।9.12।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: But the great souls, O Arjuna! Filled with my divine spirit, they worship me, fix their minds on me alone, for they know that I am the imperishable source of being.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: But the great souls, O Arjuna! Filled with my divine spirit, they worship me, fix their minds on me alone, for they know that I am the imperishable source of being.
metadata.sanskrit_text: महात्मानस्तु मां पार्थ दैवीं प्रकृतिमाश्रिताः। भजन्त्यनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिमव्ययम्।।9.13।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: Always extolling Me, they are strenuous and firm in their vows, prostrating themselves before Me, and worshiping Me continually with concentrated devotion.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: Always extolling Me, they are strenuous and firm in their vows, prostrating themselves before Me, and worshiping Me continually with concentrated devotion.
metadata.sanskrit_text: सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः। नमस्यन्तश्च मां भक्त्या नित्ययुक्ता उपासते।।9.14।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: Others worship Me with full consciousness as the One, the Manifold, the Omnipresent, and the Universal.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: Others worship Me with full consciousness as the One, the Manifold, the Omnipresent, and the Universal.
metadata.sanskrit_text: ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते। एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम्।।9.15।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: I am the oblation, the sacrifice, and the worship; I am the fuel and the chant; I am the butter offered to the fire; I am the fire itself, and I am the act of offering.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: I am the oblation, the sacrifice, and the worship; I am the fuel and the chant; I am the butter offered to the fire; I am the fire itself, and I am the act of offering.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अहं क्रतुरहं यज्ञः स्वधाऽहमहमौषधम्। मंत्रोऽहमहमेवाज्यमहमग्निरहं हुतम्।।9.16।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: I am the Father of the universe, its Mother, Nourisher, and Grandfather; I am the Knowable and the Pure; I am Om, and I am the Sacred Scriptures.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: I am the Father of the universe, its Mother, Nourisher, and Grandfather; I am the Knowable and the Pure; I am Om, and I am the Sacred Scriptures.
metadata.sanskrit_text: पिताऽहमस्य जगतो माता धाता पितामहः। वेद्यं पवित्रमोंकार ऋक् साम यजुरेव च।।9.17।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: I am the goal, the sustainer, the Lord, the witness, the home, the shelter, the lover, and the origin; I am life and death; I am the fountain and the imperishable seed.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: I am the goal, the sustainer, the Lord, the witness, the home, the shelter, the lover, and the origin; I am life and death; I am the fountain and the imperishable seed.
metadata.sanskrit_text: गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत्। प्रभवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम्।।9.18।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: I am the heat of the sun, I release and withhold the rain. I am death and immortality; I am being and non-being.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: I am the heat of the sun, I release and withhold the rain. I am death and immortality; I am being and non-being.
metadata.sanskrit_text: तपाम्यहमहं वर्षं निगृह्णाम्युत्सृजामि च। अमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च सदसच्चाहमर्जुन।।9.19।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: Those who are versed in the scriptures, who drink the mystic Soma-juice and are purified from sin, and who, while worshipping Me with sacrifices, pray that I will lead them to heaven; they reach the holy world where the Controller of the Powers of Nature resides, and they enjoy the feasts of Paradise.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: Those who are versed in the scriptures, who drink the mystic Soma-juice and are purified from sin, and who, while worshipping Me with sacrifices, pray that I will lead them to heaven; they reach the holy world where the Controller of the Powers of Nature resides, and they enjoy the feasts of Paradise.
metadata.sanskrit_text: त्रैविद्या मां सोमपाः पूतपापा यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयन्ते। ते पुण्यमासाद्य सुरेन्द्रलोक मश्नन्ति दिव्यान्दिवि देवभोगान्।।9.20।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: Yet, although they enjoy the spacious glories of Paradise, when their merit is exhausted, they are born again into this world of mortals. They have followed the letter of the scriptures, yet, because they have sought to fulfill their own desires, they must depart and return again and again.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: Yet, although they enjoy the spacious glories of Paradise, when their merit is exhausted, they are born again into this world of mortals. They have followed the letter of the scriptures, yet, because they have sought to fulfill their own desires, they must depart and return again and again.
metadata.sanskrit_text: ते तं भुक्त्वा स्वर्गलोकं विशालं क्षीणे पुण्ये मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति। एव त्रयीधर्ममनुप्रपन्ना गतागतं कामकामा लभन्ते।।9.21।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: But if a person meditates on Me and Me alone, worships Me always and everywhere, I will take upon Myself the fulfillment of their aspiration, and I will safeguard whatever they attain.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: But if a person meditates on Me and Me alone, worships Me always and everywhere, I will take upon Myself the fulfillment of their aspiration, and I will safeguard whatever they attain.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते। तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम्।।9.22।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: Even those who worship the lesser powers, if they do so with faith, they are thereby worshipping Me, though not in the correct manner.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: Even those who worship the lesser powers, if they do so with faith, they are thereby worshipping Me, though not in the correct manner.
metadata.sanskrit_text: येऽप्यन्यदेवता भक्ता यजन्ते श्रद्धयाऽन्विताः। तेऽपि मामेव कौन्तेय यजन्त्यविधिपूर्वकम्।।9.23।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: I am the willing recipient of sacrifice, and I am its true Lord. But they do not know me truly, so they fall back.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: I am the willing recipient of sacrifice, and I am its true Lord. But they do not know me truly, so they fall back.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च। न तु मामभिजानन्ति तत्त्वेनातश्च्यवन्ति ते।।9.24।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: The votaries of the lesser powers go to them; the devotees of spirits go to them; they who worship the powers of darkness, to such powers shall they go; and so too, those who worship me shall come to me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: The votaries of the lesser powers go to them; the devotees of spirits go to them; they who worship the powers of darkness, to such powers shall they go; and so too, those who worship me shall come to me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: यान्ति देवव्रता देवान् पितृ़न्यान्ति पितृव्रताः। भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनोऽपि माम्।।9.25।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: Whatever a person offers to Me, be it a leaf, flower, fruit, or water, I accept it, for it is offered with devotion and a pure mind.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: Whatever a person offers to Me, be it a leaf, flower, fruit, or water, I accept it, for it is offered with devotion and a pure mind.
metadata.sanskrit_text: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति। तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः।।9.26।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you sacrifice and give, whatever austerities you practice, do all as an offering to Me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you sacrifice and give, whatever austerities you practice, do all as an offering to Me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: यत्करोषि यदश्नासि यज्जुहोषि ददासि यत्। यत्तपस्यसि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम्।।9.27।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: So, your action will have no result, either good or bad; but, through the spirit of renunciation, you will come to Me and be free.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: So, your action will have no result, either good or bad; but, through the spirit of renunciation, you will come to Me and be free.
metadata.sanskrit_text: शुभाशुभफलैरेवं मोक्ष्यसे कर्मबन्धनैः। संन्यासयोगयुक्तात्मा विमुक्तो मामुपैष्यसि।।9.28।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: I am the same to all beings; I do not favour any, nor do I hate any. However, those who worship Me devotedly, they live in Me and I in them.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: I am the same to all beings; I do not favour any, nor do I hate any. However, those who worship Me devotedly, they live in Me and I in them.
metadata.sanskrit_text: समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः। ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम्।।9.29।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: Even the most sinful, if he worships Me with his whole heart, shall be considered righteous, for he is treading the right path.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: Even the most sinful, if he worships Me with his whole heart, shall be considered righteous, for he is treading the right path.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अपि चेत्सुदुराचारो भजते मामनन्यभाक्। साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः।।9.30।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: He will soon attain spirituality and eternal peace. O Arjuna! Believe me, my devotee is never lost.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: He will soon attain spirituality and eternal peace. O Arjuna! Believe me, my devotee is never lost.
metadata.sanskrit_text: क्षिप्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति। कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति।।9.31।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: Even the children of sinful parents, those miscalled the weaker sex, merchants, and laborers, if they make Me their refuge, they shall attain the highest.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: Even the children of sinful parents, those miscalled the weaker sex, merchants, and laborers, if they make Me their refuge, they shall attain the highest.
metadata.sanskrit_text: मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः। स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम्।।9.32।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: What need is there, then, to mention the holy ministers of God, the devotees, and the saintly rulers? Therefore, do you, born in this changing and miserable world, also worship Me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: What need is there, then, to mention the holy ministers of God, the devotees, and the saintly rulers? Therefore, do you, born in this changing and miserable world, also worship Me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: किं पुनर्ब्राह्मणाः पुण्या भक्ता राजर्षयस्तथा। अनित्यमसुखं लोकमिमं प्राप्य भजस्व माम्।।9.33।।

document:
Chapter: Raja Vidya Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
Translation: Fix your mind on Me, devote yourself to Me, sacrifice for Me, surrender to Me, make Me the object of your aspirations, and you shall assuredly become one with Me, Who am your own Self.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the King of Sciences
metadata.english_translation: Fix your mind on Me, devote yourself to Me, sacrifice for Me, surrender to Me, make Me the object of your aspirations, and you shall assuredly become one with Me, Who am your own Self.
metadata.sanskrit_text: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु। मामेवैष्यसि युक्त्वैवमात्मानं मत्परायणः।।9.34।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: Lord Shri Krishna said: Now, O Prince! Listen to My supreme advice, which I give you for the sake of your welfare, for you are My beloved.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna said: Now, O Prince! Listen to My supreme advice, which I give you for the sake of your welfare, for you are My beloved.
metadata.sanskrit_text: श्री भगवानुवाच भूय एव महाबाहो श्रृणु मे परमं वचः। यत्तेऽहं प्रीयमाणाय वक्ष्यामि हितकाम्यया।।10.1।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: Neither the professors of divinity nor the great ascetics know My origin, for I am the source from which they all originate.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: Neither the professors of divinity nor the great ascetics know My origin, for I am the source from which they all originate.
metadata.sanskrit_text: न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः। अहमादिर्हि देवानां महर्षीणां च सर्वशः।।10.2।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: He who knows Me as the unborn, without beginning, the Lord of the universe, he, stripped of his delusions, becomes free from all conceivable sins.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: He who knows Me as the unborn, without beginning, the Lord of the universe, he, stripped of his delusions, becomes free from all conceivable sins.
metadata.sanskrit_text: यो मामजमनादिं च वेत्ति लोकमहेश्वरम्। असम्मूढः स मर्त्येषु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते।।10.3।।

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: Intelligence, wisdom, non-delusion, forgiveness, truth, self-control, calmness, pleasure, pain, birth, death, fear, and fearlessness;
metadata.sanskrit_text: बुद्धिर्ज्ञानमसंमोहः क्षमा सत्यं दमः शमः। सुखं दुःखं भवोऽभावो भयं चाभयमेव च।।10.4।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: Harmlessness, equanimity, contentment, austerity, beneficence, fame, and failure—all these characteristics of beings spring from Me alone.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: Harmlessness, equanimity, contentment, austerity, beneficence, fame, and failure—all these characteristics of beings spring from Me alone.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अहिंसा समता तुष्टिस्तपो दानं यशोऽयशः। भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः।।10.5।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: The seven Great Seers, the progenitors of mankind, the Ancient Four, and the Lawgivers were born of My will and come forth directly from Me. The race of mankind has sprung from them. (Mareechi, Atri, Angira, Pulah, Kratu, Pulastya, Vahishta; the Masters: Sanak, Sanandan, Sanatan, Sanatkumar.)

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: The seven Great Seers, the progenitors of mankind, the Ancient Four, and the Lawgivers were born of My will and come forth directly from Me. The race of mankind has sprung from them. (Mareechi, Atri, Angira, Pulah, Kratu, Pulastya, Vahishta; the Masters: Sanak, Sanandan, Sanatan, Sanatkumar.)
metadata.sanskrit_text: महर्षयः सप्त पूर्वे चत्वारो मनवस्तथा। मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः।।10.6।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: He who rightly understands My manifested glory and My creative power attains perfect peace without a doubt.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: He who rightly understands My manifested glory and My creative power attains perfect peace without a doubt.
metadata.sanskrit_text: एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः। सोऽविकम्पेन योगेन युज्यते नात्र संशयः।।10.7।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: I am the source of all; from me everything flows. Therefore, the wise worship me with an unchanging devotion.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: I am the source of all; from me everything flows. Therefore, the wise worship me with an unchanging devotion.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते। इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः।।10.8।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: With minds concentrated on Me, with lives absorbed in Me, and enlightening one another, they ever feel content and happy.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: With minds concentrated on Me, with lives absorbed in Me, and enlightening one another, they ever feel content and happy.
metadata.sanskrit_text: मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम्। कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च।।10.9।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: To those who are always devout and who worship Me with love, I give the power of discrimination that leads them to Me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: To those who are always devout and who worship Me with love, I give the power of discrimination that leads them to Me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: तेषां सततयुक्तानां भजतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम्। ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते।।10.10।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: By My grace, I live in their hearts, and I dispel the darkness of ignorance with the shining light of wisdom.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: By My grace, I live in their hearts, and I dispel the darkness of ignorance with the shining light of wisdom.
metadata.sanskrit_text: तेषामेवानुकम्पार्थमहमज्ञानजं तमः। नाशयाम्यात्मभावस्थो ज्ञानदीपेन भास्वता।।10.11।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: Arjuna asked: Thou art the Supreme Spirit, the Eternal Home, the Holiest of Holies, the Eternal Divine Self, the Primal God, the Unborn, and Omnipresent.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: Arjuna asked: Thou art the Supreme Spirit, the Eternal Home, the Holiest of Holies, the Eternal Divine Self, the Primal God, the Unborn, and Omnipresent.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अर्जुन उवाच परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान्। पुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यमादिदेवमजं विभुम्।।10.12।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: So have said the seers, the divine sage Narada, Asita, Devala, and Vyasa; and Thou Thyself also sayest it.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: So have said the seers, the divine sage Narada, Asita, Devala, and Vyasa; and Thou Thyself also sayest it.
metadata.sanskrit_text: आहुस्त्वामृषयः सर्वे देवर्षिर्नारदस्तथा। असितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे।।10.13।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: I believe in what You have said, my Lord! For neither the godly nor the godless comprehend Your manifestation.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: I believe in what You have said, my Lord! For neither the godly nor the godless comprehend Your manifestation.
metadata.sanskrit_text: सर्वमेतदृतं मन्ये यन्मां वदसि केशव। न हि ते भगवन् व्यक्ितं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः।।10.14।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: You alone know Yourself, by the power of Your Self; You are the Supreme Spirit, the Source and Master of all being, the Lord of Lords, the Ruler of the Universe.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: You alone know Yourself, by the power of Your Self; You are the Supreme Spirit, the Source and Master of all being, the Lord of Lords, the Ruler of the Universe.
metadata.sanskrit_text: स्वयमेवात्मनाऽत्मानं वेत्थ त्वं पुरुषोत्तम। भूतभावन भूतेश देवदेव जगत्पते।।10.15।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: Please tell me about all of Your glorious manifestations, through which You pervade the world.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: Please tell me about all of Your glorious manifestations, through which You pervade the world.
metadata.sanskrit_text: वक्तुमर्हस्यशेषेण दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः। याभिर्विभूतिभिर्लोकानिमांस्त्वं व्याप्य तिष्ठसि।।10.16।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: O Master! How can I, through constant meditation, come to know You? My Lord! What are Your various manifestations through which I can meditate on You?

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: O Master! How can I, through constant meditation, come to know You? My Lord! What are Your various manifestations through which I can meditate on You?
metadata.sanskrit_text: कथं विद्यामहं योगिंस्त्वां सदा परिचिन्तयन्। केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन्मया।।10.17।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: Tell me again, I pray, of Thy power and Thy glory in full; for I feel that I am never satisfied when I listen to Thy immortal words.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: Tell me again, I pray, of Thy power and Thy glory in full; for I feel that I am never satisfied when I listen to Thy immortal words.
metadata.sanskrit_text: विस्तरेणात्मनो योगं विभूतिं च जनार्दन। भूयः कथय तृप्तिर्हि श्रृण्वतो नास्ति मेऽमृतम्।।10.18।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: So be it, My beloved friend! I will unfold to you some of the chief aspects of My glory. There is no end to its full extent.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: So be it, My beloved friend! I will unfold to you some of the chief aspects of My glory. There is no end to its full extent.
metadata.sanskrit_text: श्री भगवानुवाच हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः। प्राधान्यतः कुरुश्रेष्ठ नास्त्यन्तो विस्तरस्य मे।।10.19।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: O Arjuna! I am the Self, seated in the hearts of all beings; I am the beginning, the life, and the end of them all.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: O Arjuna! I am the Self, seated in the hearts of all beings; I am the beginning, the life, and the end of them all.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः। अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च।।10.20।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: Of all the creative powers, I am the Creator; of luminaries, the Sun; of winds, the Whirlwind; and of planets, the Moon.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: Of all the creative powers, I am the Creator; of luminaries, the Sun; of winds, the Whirlwind; and of planets, the Moon.
metadata.sanskrit_text: आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्ज्योतिषां रविरंशुमान्। मरीचिर्मरुतामस्मि नक्षत्राणामहं शशी।।10.21।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: Of the Vedas, I am the hymns; I am the electric force in the powers of nature; of the senses, I am the mind; and I am the intelligence in all that lives.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: Of the Vedas, I am the hymns; I am the electric force in the powers of nature; of the senses, I am the mind; and I am the intelligence in all that lives.
metadata.sanskrit_text: वेदानां सामवेदोऽस्मि देवानामस्मि वासवः। इन्द्रियाणां मनश्चास्मि भूतानामस्मि चेतना।।10.22।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: Among forces of vitality, I am the life; I am Mammon to the heathens and the godless; I am the energy in fire, earth, wind, sky, heaven, sun, moon, and planets; and among mountains, I am Mount Meru.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: Among forces of vitality, I am the life; I am Mammon to the heathens and the godless; I am the energy in fire, earth, wind, sky, heaven, sun, moon, and planets; and among mountains, I am Mount Meru.
metadata.sanskrit_text: रुद्राणां शङ्करश्चास्मि वित्तेशो यक्षरक्षसाम्। वसूनां पावकश्चास्मि मेरुः शिखरिणामहम्।।10.23।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: Among the priests, know, O Arjuna, that I am the priest Brihaspati; of generals, I am Skanda, the Commander-in-Chief, and of waters, I am the Ocean.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: Among the priests, know, O Arjuna, that I am the priest Brihaspati; of generals, I am Skanda, the Commander-in-Chief, and of waters, I am the Ocean.
metadata.sanskrit_text: पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम्। सेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः सरसामस्मि सागरः।।10.24।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: Of the great seers, I am Bhrigu; of words, I am Om; of offerings, I am the silent prayer; among things immovable, I am the Himalayas.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: Of the great seers, I am Bhrigu; of words, I am Om; of offerings, I am the silent prayer; among things immovable, I am the Himalayas.
metadata.sanskrit_text: महर्षीणां भृगुरहं गिरामस्म्येकमक्षरम्। यज्ञानां जपयज्ञोऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः।।10.25।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: Of trees, I am the sacred fig tree; of divine seers, Narada; of heavenly singers, I am Chitraratha, their leader; and of sages, I am Kapila.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: Of trees, I am the sacred fig tree; of divine seers, Narada; of heavenly singers, I am Chitraratha, their leader; and of sages, I am Kapila.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां देवर्षीणां च नारदः। गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः।।10.26।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: Know that among horses I am Pegasus, heaven-born; among the lordly elephants I am the white one, and I am the ruler among men.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: Know that among horses I am Pegasus, heaven-born; among the lordly elephants I am the white one, and I am the ruler among men.
metadata.sanskrit_text: उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां विद्धि माममृतोद्भवम्। ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणां च नराधिपम्।।10.27।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: I am the thunderbolt among weapons; I am the Cow of Plenty among cows; I am Passion in those who procreate, and I am the Cobra among serpents.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: I am the thunderbolt among weapons; I am the Cow of Plenty among cows; I am Passion in those who procreate, and I am the Cobra among serpents.
metadata.sanskrit_text: आयुधानामहं वज्रं धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक्। प्रजनश्चास्मि कन्दर्पः सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः।।10.28।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: I am the king-python among snakes, I am the aqueous principle among those that live in water, I am the father of fathers, and among rulers I am death.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: I am the king-python among snakes, I am the aqueous principle among those that live in water, I am the father of fathers, and among rulers I am death.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अनन्तश्चास्मि नागानां वरुणो यादसामहम्। पितृ़णामर्यमा चास्मि यमः संयमतामहम्।।10.29।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: And I am the devotee Prahlada among the heathens; of Time I am the Eternal Present; I am the Lion among beasts and the Eagle among birds.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: And I am the devotee Prahlada among the heathens; of Time I am the Eternal Present; I am the Lion among beasts and the Eagle among birds.
metadata.sanskrit_text: प्रह्लादश्चास्मि दैत्यानां कालः कलयतामहम्। मृगाणां च मृगेन्द्रोऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम्।।10.30।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: I am the wind among purifiers, the king Rama among warriors; I am the crocodile among fishes, and I am the Ganges among rivers.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: I am the wind among purifiers, the king Rama among warriors; I am the crocodile among fishes, and I am the Ganges among rivers.
metadata.sanskrit_text: पवनः पवतामस्मि रामः शस्त्रभृतामहम्। झषाणां मकरश्चास्मि स्रोतसामस्मि जाह्नवी।।10.31।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: I am the beginning, the middle, and the end of creation; among sciences, I am the science of spirituality; I am the discussion among disputants.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: I am the beginning, the middle, and the end of creation; among sciences, I am the science of spirituality; I am the discussion among disputants.
metadata.sanskrit_text: सर्गाणामादिरन्तश्च मध्यं चैवाहमर्जुन। अध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानां वादः प्रवदतामहम्।।10.32।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: Of letters, I am A; I am the copulative in compound words; I am inexhaustible Time; and I am the all-pervading Preserver.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: Of letters, I am A; I am the copulative in compound words; I am inexhaustible Time; and I am the all-pervading Preserver.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि द्वन्द्वः सामासिकस्य च। अहमेवाक्षयः कालो धाताऽहं विश्वतोमुखः।।10.33।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: I am all-devouring Death; I am the Origin of all that will happen; I am Fame, Fortune, Speech, Memory, Intellect, Constancy, and Forgiveness.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: I am all-devouring Death; I am the Origin of all that will happen; I am Fame, Fortune, Speech, Memory, Intellect, Constancy, and Forgiveness.
metadata.sanskrit_text: मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम्। कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा।।10.34।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: Of hymns, I am Brihatsama; of meters, I am Garatri; among months, I am Margasheersha (December); and I am Spring among seasons.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: Of hymns, I am Brihatsama; of meters, I am Garatri; among months, I am Margasheersha (December); and I am Spring among seasons.
metadata.sanskrit_text: बृहत्साम तथा साम्नां गायत्री छन्दसामहम्। मासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहमृतूनां कुसुमाकरः।।10.35।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: I am the gambler's cheat and the splendor of the splendid; I am victory; I am effort; and I am the purity of the pure.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: I am the gambler's cheat and the splendor of the splendid; I am victory; I am effort; and I am the purity of the pure.
metadata.sanskrit_text: द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्। जयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम्।।10.36।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: I am Shri Krishna among the Vishnu-clan, Arjuna among the Pandavas, Vyasa among the saints, and Shukracharya among the sages.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: I am Shri Krishna among the Vishnu-clan, Arjuna among the Pandavas, Vyasa among the saints, and Shukracharya among the sages.
metadata.sanskrit_text: वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनंजयः। मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशना कविः।।10.37।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: I am the scepter of rulers, the strategy of conquerors, the silence of mystery, and the wisdom of the wise.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: I am the scepter of rulers, the strategy of conquerors, the silence of mystery, and the wisdom of the wise.
metadata.sanskrit_text: दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम्। मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम्।।10.38।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: I am the seed of all beings, O Arjuna! No creature, moving or unmoving, can live without Me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: I am the seed of all beings, O Arjuna! No creature, moving or unmoving, can live without Me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदहमर्जुन। न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम्।।10.39।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: O Arjuna! The aspects of My divine life are endless; I have mentioned only a few as an example.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
