metadata.english_translation: O Arjuna! The aspects of My divine life are endless; I have mentioned only a few as an example.
metadata.sanskrit_text: नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परंतप। एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया।।10.40।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: Whatever is glorious, excellent, beautiful, and mighty, be assured that it comes from a fragment of My splendor.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: Whatever is glorious, excellent, beautiful, and mighty, be assured that it comes from a fragment of My splendor.
metadata.sanskrit_text: यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा। तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसंभवम्।।10.41।।

document:
Chapter: Vibhooti Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
Translation: But what is the use of all these details to you, O Arjuna? I sustain this universe with only a small part of Myself.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Appreciating the Infinite Opulences of God
metadata.english_translation: But what is the use of all these details to you, O Arjuna? I sustain this universe with only a small part of Myself.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन। विष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत्।।10.42।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Arjuna said: My Lord! Your words concerning the Supreme Secret of Self, given for my blessing, have dispelled the illusions that surrounded me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Arjuna said: My Lord! Your words concerning the Supreme Secret of Self, given for my blessing, have dispelled the illusions that surrounded me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अर्जुन उवाच मदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम्। यत्त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहोऽयं विगतो मम।।11.1।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: O Lord, whose eyes are like the lotus petal! You have described in detail the origin and dissolution of beings, and Your own Eternal Majesty.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: O Lord, whose eyes are like the lotus petal! You have described in detail the origin and dissolution of beings, and Your own Eternal Majesty.
metadata.sanskrit_text: भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया। त्वत्तः कमलपत्राक्ष माहात्म्यमपि चाव्ययम्।।11.2।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: I believe all as you have declared it. I now long to have a vision of your divine form, O Most High!

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: I believe all as you have declared it. I now long to have a vision of your divine form, O Most High!
metadata.sanskrit_text: एवमेतद्यथात्थ त्वमात्मानं परमेश्वर। द्रष्टुमिच्छामि ते रूपमैश्वरं पुरुषोत्तम।।11.3।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: If you think it is possible for me to see it, show me, O Lord of Lords, your eternal self.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: If you think it is possible for me to see it, show me, O Lord of Lords, your eternal self.
metadata.sanskrit_text: मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्टुमिति प्रभो। योगेश्वर ततो मे त्वं दर्शयाऽत्मानमव्ययम्।।11.4।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: "Behold, O Arjuna! My celestial forms, by the hundreds and thousands, various in kind, color, and shape."

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: "Behold, O Arjuna! My celestial forms, by the hundreds and thousands, various in kind, color, and shape."
metadata.sanskrit_text: श्री भगवानुवाच पश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। नानाविधानि दिव्यानि नानावर्णाकृतीनि च।।11.5।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Behold, thou seest the powers of Nature: fire, earth, wind, and sky; the sun, the heavens, the moon, the stars; all forces of vitality and healing; and the roving winds. Behold, thou seest the myriad wonders revealed to none but thee.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Behold, thou seest the powers of Nature: fire, earth, wind, and sky; the sun, the heavens, the moon, the stars; all forces of vitality and healing; and the roving winds. Behold, thou seest the myriad wonders revealed to none but thee.
metadata.sanskrit_text: पश्यादित्यान्वसून्रुद्रानश्िवनौ मरुतस्तथा। बहून्यदृष्टपूर्वाणि पश्याऽश्चर्याणि भारत।।11.6।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Here, living in Me, O Arjuna, behold the entire universe, both movable and immovable, and anything else you would like to see!

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Here, living in Me, O Arjuna, behold the entire universe, both movable and immovable, and anything else you would like to see!
metadata.sanskrit_text: इहैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं पश्याद्य सचराचरम्। मम देहे गुडाकेश यच्चान्यद्द्रष्टुमिच्छसि।।11.7।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Yet, since you cannot see Me with mortal eyes, behold, I give you divine sight. Now, see the glory of My sovereignty.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Yet, since you cannot see Me with mortal eyes, behold, I give you divine sight. Now, see the glory of My sovereignty.
metadata.sanskrit_text: न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुमनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा। दिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्।।11.8।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Sanjaya continued: "Having thus spoken, O King, the Lord Shri Krishna, the Almighty Prince of Wisdom, showed Arjuna the Supreme Form of the Great God.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Sanjaya continued: "Having thus spoken, O King, the Lord Shri Krishna, the Almighty Prince of Wisdom, showed Arjuna the Supreme Form of the Great God.
metadata.sanskrit_text: सञ्जय उवाच एवमुक्त्वा ततो राजन्महायोगेश्वरो हरिः। दर्शयामास पार्थाय परमं रूपमैश्वरम्।।11.9।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: There were countless eyes, mouths, and innumerable mystic forms, with shining ornaments and flaming celestial weapons.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: There were countless eyes, mouths, and innumerable mystic forms, with shining ornaments and flaming celestial weapons.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अनेकवक्त्रनयनमनेकाद्भुतदर्शनम्। अनेकदिव्याभरणं दिव्यानेकोद्यतायुधम्।।11.10।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Crowned with heavenly garlands, clothed in shining garments, anointed with divine unguents, He showed Himself as the Resplendent One, Marvelous, Boundless, and Omnipresent.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Crowned with heavenly garlands, clothed in shining garments, anointed with divine unguents, He showed Himself as the Resplendent One, Marvelous, Boundless, and Omnipresent.
metadata.sanskrit_text: दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम्। सर्वाश्चर्यमयं देवमनन्तं विश्वतोमुखम्।।11.11।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Could a thousand suns blaze forth together, it would be but a faint reflection of the radiance of the Lord God.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Could a thousand suns blaze forth together, it would be but a faint reflection of the radiance of the Lord God.
metadata.sanskrit_text: दिवि सूर्यसहस्रस्य भवेद्युगपदुत्थिता। यदि भाः सदृशी सा स्याद्भासस्तस्य महात्मनः।।11.12।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: In that vision, Arjuna saw the universe, with its manifold shapes, all embraced in one, its Supreme Lord.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: In that vision, Arjuna saw the universe, with its manifold shapes, all embraced in one, its Supreme Lord.
metadata.sanskrit_text: तत्रैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं प्रविभक्तमनेकधा। अपश्यद्देवदेवस्य शरीरे पाण्डवस्तदा।।11.13।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Then, Arjuna, filled with awe, his hair standing on end, bowing his head, and clasping his hands in reverence, spoke to the Lord:

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Then, Arjuna, filled with awe, his hair standing on end, bowing his head, and clasping his hands in reverence, spoke to the Lord:
metadata.sanskrit_text: ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो हृष्टरोमा धनञ्जयः। प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं कृताञ्जलिरभाषत।।11.14।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Arjuna said: O Almighty God! I see in You the powers of Nature, the various creatures of the world, the Progenitor on His lotus throne, the Sages, and the shining angels.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Arjuna said: O Almighty God! I see in You the powers of Nature, the various creatures of the world, the Progenitor on His lotus throne, the Sages, and the shining angels.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अर्जुन उवाच पश्यामि देवांस्तव देव देहे सर्वांस्तथा भूतविशेषसङ्घान्। ब्रह्माणमीशं कमलासनस्थ मृषींश्च सर्वानुरगांश्च दिव्यान्।।11.15।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: I see You, infinite in form, with faces, eyes, and limbs everywhere; with no beginning, middle, or end. O You, Lord of the Universe, whose form is universal!

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: I see You, infinite in form, with faces, eyes, and limbs everywhere; with no beginning, middle, or end. O You, Lord of the Universe, whose form is universal!
metadata.sanskrit_text: अनेकबाहूदरवक्त्रनेत्रं पश्यामि त्वां सर्वतोऽनन्तरूपम्। नान्तं न मध्यं न पुनस्तवादिं पश्यामि विश्वेश्वर विश्वरूप।।11.16।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: I see you with the crown, the scepter, and the discus; a blaze of splendor. Scarcely can I gaze upon you, so radiant you are, glowing like a blazing fire, brilliant as the sun, immeasurable.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: I see you with the crown, the scepter, and the discus; a blaze of splendor. Scarcely can I gaze upon you, so radiant you are, glowing like a blazing fire, brilliant as the sun, immeasurable.
metadata.sanskrit_text: किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रिणं च तेजोराशिं सर्वतोदीप्तिमन्तम्। पश्यामि त्वां दुर्निरीक्ष्यं समन्ता द्दीप्तानलार्कद्युतिमप्रमेयम्।।11.17।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: You are imperishable, the only one worthy of being known, the priceless treasure-house of the universe, the immortal guardian of eternal life, and the everlasting spirit.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: You are imperishable, the only one worthy of being known, the priceless treasure-house of the universe, the immortal guardian of eternal life, and the everlasting spirit.
metadata.sanskrit_text: त्वमक्षरं परमं वेदितव्यं त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम्। त्वमव्ययः शाश्वतधर्मगोप्ता सनातनस्त्वं पुरुषो मतो मे।।11.18।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Without beginning, without middle, and without end, infinite in power, with arms all-embracing, the sun and moon as Your eyes, Your face beaming with the fire of sacrifice, flooding the whole universe with light.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Without beginning, without middle, and without end, infinite in power, with arms all-embracing, the sun and moon as Your eyes, Your face beaming with the fire of sacrifice, flooding the whole universe with light.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अनादिमध्यान्तमनन्तवीर्य मनन्तबाहुं शशिसूर्यनेत्रम्। पश्यामि त्वां दीप्तहुताशवक्त्रम् स्वतेजसा विश्वमिदं तपन्तम्।।11.19।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Alone, you fill all the quarters of the sky, earth, and heaven, and the regions between. O Almighty Lord! Seeing your marvelous and awe-inspiring form, the spheres tremble with fear.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Alone, you fill all the quarters of the sky, earth, and heaven, and the regions between. O Almighty Lord! Seeing your marvelous and awe-inspiring form, the spheres tremble with fear.
metadata.sanskrit_text: द्यावापृथिव्योरिदमन्तरं हि व्याप्तं त्वयैकेन दिशश्च सर्वाः। दृष्ट्वाऽद्भुतं रूपमुग्रं तवेदं लोकत्रयं प्रव्यथितं महात्मन्।।11.20।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: The troops of celestial beings enter into You, some invoking You in fear, with folded palms; the great seers and adepts sing hymns to Your glory, saying, "All hail!"

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: The troops of celestial beings enter into You, some invoking You in fear, with folded palms; the great seers and adepts sing hymns to Your glory, saying, "All hail!"
metadata.sanskrit_text: अमी हि त्वां सुरसङ्घाः विशन्ति केचिद्भीताः प्राञ्जलयो गृणन्ति। स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा महर्षिसिद्धसङ्घाः स्तुवन्ति त्वां स्तुतिभिः पुष्कलाभिः।।11.21।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: The vital forces, major stars, fire, earth, air, sky, sun, heaven, moon, and planets; the angels, guardians of the universe, divine healers, winds, fathers, heavenly singers, and hosts of mammon-worshippers, demons, and saints are all amazed.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: The vital forces, major stars, fire, earth, air, sky, sun, heaven, moon, and planets; the angels, guardians of the universe, divine healers, winds, fathers, heavenly singers, and hosts of mammon-worshippers, demons, and saints are all amazed.
metadata.sanskrit_text: रुद्रादित्या वसवो ये च साध्या विश्वेऽश्िवनौ मरुतश्चोष्मपाश्च। गन्धर्वयक्षासुरसिद्धसङ्घा वीक्षन्ते त्वां विस्मिताश्चैव सर्वे।।11.22।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Seeing Thy stupendous Form, O Most Mighty One, with its myriad faces, its innumerable eyes, limbs, and terrible jaws, I myself and all the worlds are overwhelmed with awe.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Seeing Thy stupendous Form, O Most Mighty One, with its myriad faces, its innumerable eyes, limbs, and terrible jaws, I myself and all the worlds are overwhelmed with awe.
metadata.sanskrit_text: रूपं महत्ते बहुवक्त्रनेत्रं महाबाहो बहुबाहूरुपादम्। बहूदरं बहुदंष्ट्राकरालं दृष्ट्वा लोकाः प्रव्यथितास्तथाऽहम्।।11.23।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: When I see You, touching the heavens, glowing with color, with open mouth and wide, fiery eyes, I am terrified. O my Lord! My courage and peace of mind abandon me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: When I see You, touching the heavens, glowing with color, with open mouth and wide, fiery eyes, I am terrified. O my Lord! My courage and peace of mind abandon me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: नभःस्पृशं दीप्तमनेकवर्णं व्यात्ताननं दीप्तविशालनेत्रम्। दृष्ट्वा हि त्वां प्रव्यथितान्तरात्मा धृतिं न विन्दामि शमं च विष्णो।।11.24।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: When I see Thy mouths with their fearful jaws, like glowing fires at the dissolution of creation, I lose all sense of place and find no rest. Be merciful, O Lord, in whom this universe abides!

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: When I see Thy mouths with their fearful jaws, like glowing fires at the dissolution of creation, I lose all sense of place and find no rest. Be merciful, O Lord, in whom this universe abides!
metadata.sanskrit_text: दंष्ट्राकरालानि च ते मुखानि दृष्ट्वैव कालानलसन्निभानि। दिशो न जाने न लभे च शर्म प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास।।11.25।।

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: All these sons of Dhritarashtra, along with the hosts of princes, Bheeshma, Drona, and Karna, as well as the other warrior chiefs on our side;
metadata.sanskrit_text: अमी च त्वां धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राः सर्वे सहैवावनिपालसङ्घैः। भीष्मो द्रोणः सूतपुत्रस्तथाऽसौ सहास्मदीयैरपि योधमुख्यैः।।11.26।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: 1 See them all rushing headlong into Thy mouths, with terrible tusks, horrible to behold. Some are mangled between Thy jaws, with their heads crushed to atoms.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: 1 See them all rushing headlong into Thy mouths, with terrible tusks, horrible to behold. Some are mangled between Thy jaws, with their heads crushed to atoms.
metadata.sanskrit_text: वक्त्राणि ते त्वरमाणा विशन्ति दंष्ट्राकरालानि भयानकानि। केचिद्विलग्ना दशनान्तरेषु संदृश्यन्ते चूर्णितैरुत्तमाङ्गैः।।11.27।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: As rivers in flood surge furiously towards the ocean, so these heroes, the greatest among men, fling themselves into Thy flaming mouths.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: As rivers in flood surge furiously towards the ocean, so these heroes, the greatest among men, fling themselves into Thy flaming mouths.
metadata.sanskrit_text: यथा नदीनां बहवोऽम्बुवेगाः समुद्रमेवाभिमुखाः द्रवन्ति। तथा तवामी नरलोकवीरा विशन्ति वक्त्राण्यभिविज्वलन्ति।।11.28।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: As moths impetuously fly towards the flame, only to be killed, so these men rush into Your mouths to court their own destruction.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: As moths impetuously fly towards the flame, only to be killed, so these men rush into Your mouths to court their own destruction.
metadata.sanskrit_text: यथा प्रदीप्तं ज्वलनं पतङ्गा विशन्ति नाशाय समृद्धवेगाः। तथैव नाशाय विशन्ति लोका स्तवापि वक्त्राणि समृद्धवेगाः।।11.29।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: You seem to swallow up the worlds, lapping them in flame. Your glory fills the universe. Your fierce rays beat down upon it irresistibly.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: You seem to swallow up the worlds, lapping them in flame. Your glory fills the universe. Your fierce rays beat down upon it irresistibly.
metadata.sanskrit_text: लेलिह्यसे ग्रसमानः समन्ता ल्लोकान्समग्रान्वदनैर्ज्वलद्भिः। तेजोभिरापूर्य जगत्समग्रं भासस्तवोग्राः प्रतपन्ति विष्णो।।11.30।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Tell me then, who are You, who wears this dreadful form? I bow before You, O Mighty One! Have mercy, I pray, and let me see You as You were at first. I do not know what Your intentions are.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Tell me then, who are You, who wears this dreadful form? I bow before You, O Mighty One! Have mercy, I pray, and let me see You as You were at first. I do not know what Your intentions are.
metadata.sanskrit_text: आख्याहि मे को भवानुग्ररूपो नमोऽस्तु ते देववर प्रसीद। विज्ञातुमिच्छामि भवन्तमाद्यं न हि प्रजानामि तव प्रवृत्तिम्।।11.31।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: I have shown myself to you as the Destroyer who lays waste the world and whose purpose is destruction. In spite of your efforts, all these warriors gathered for battle shall not escape death.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: I have shown myself to you as the Destroyer who lays waste the world and whose purpose is destruction. In spite of your efforts, all these warriors gathered for battle shall not escape death.
metadata.sanskrit_text: श्री भगवानुवाच कालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो लोकान्समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः। ऋतेऽपि त्वां न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे येऽवस्थिताः प्रत्यनीकेषु योधाः।।11.32।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Then gird up your loins and conquer. Subdue your foes and enjoy the kingdom in prosperity. I have already doomed them. Be thou my instrument, Arjuna!

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Then gird up your loins and conquer. Subdue your foes and enjoy the kingdom in prosperity. I have already doomed them. Be thou my instrument, Arjuna!
metadata.sanskrit_text: तस्मात्त्वमुत्तिष्ठ यशो लभस्व जित्वा शत्रून् भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यं समृद्धम्। मयैवैते निहताः पूर्वमेव निमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन्।।11.33।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Drona, Bheeshma, Jayadratha, Karna, and other brave warriors - I have condemned them all. Destroy them; fight without fear. Your foes shall be crushed."

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Drona, Bheeshma, Jayadratha, Karna, and other brave warriors - I have condemned them all. Destroy them; fight without fear. Your foes shall be crushed."
metadata.sanskrit_text: द्रोणं च भीष्मं च जयद्रथं च कर्णं तथाऽन्यानपि योधवीरान्। मया हतांस्त्वं जहि मा व्यथिष्ठा युध्यस्व जेतासि रणे सपत्नान्।।11.34।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Sanjaya continued: "Having heard these words from the Lord Shri Krishna, the Prince Arjuna, with folded hands trembling, prostrated himself and with a choked voice, bowing down again and again, and overwhelmed with awe, once more addressed the Lord.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Sanjaya continued: "Having heard these words from the Lord Shri Krishna, the Prince Arjuna, with folded hands trembling, prostrated himself and with a choked voice, bowing down again and again, and overwhelmed with awe, once more addressed the Lord.
metadata.sanskrit_text: सञ्जय उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं केशवस्य कृताञ्जलिर्वेपमानः किरीटी। नमस्कृत्वा भूय एवाह कृष्णं सगद्गदं भीतभीतः प्रणम्य।।11.35।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Arjuna said: My Lord! It is natural for the world to revel and rejoice when singing praises of Your glory; the demons fly in fear and the saints offer You their salutations.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Arjuna said: My Lord! It is natural for the world to revel and rejoice when singing praises of Your glory; the demons fly in fear and the saints offer You their salutations.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अर्जुन उवाच स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्या जगत् प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते च। रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्ति सर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसङ्घाः।।11.36।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: How else should they do? O Supreme Self, greater than the powers of creation, the first cause, infinite, the Lord of Lords, the home of the universe, imperishable, being and non-being, yet transcending both.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: How else should they do? O Supreme Self, greater than the powers of creation, the first cause, infinite, the Lord of Lords, the home of the universe, imperishable, being and non-being, yet transcending both.
metadata.sanskrit_text: कस्माच्च ते न नमेरन्महात्मन् गरीयसे ब्रह्मणोऽप्यादिकर्त्रे। अनन्त देवेश जगन्निवास त्वमक्षरं सदसत्तत्परं यत्।।11.37।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: You are the Primal God, the Ancient One, the Supreme Abode of this universe, the Knower, the Knowledge, and the Final Home. You fill everything. Your form is infinite.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: You are the Primal God, the Ancient One, the Supreme Abode of this universe, the Knower, the Knowledge, and the Final Home. You fill everything. Your form is infinite.
metadata.sanskrit_text: त्वमादिदेवः पुरुषः पुराण स्त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम्। वेत्तासि वेद्यं च परं च धाम त्वया ततं विश्वमनन्तरूप।।11.38।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: You are the wind, you are death, you are the fire, the water, the moon, the father, and the grandfather. Honor and glory to you a thousand and a thousand times! Again and again, salutations to you, O my Lord!

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: You are the wind, you are death, you are the fire, the water, the moon, the father, and the grandfather. Honor and glory to you a thousand and a thousand times! Again and again, salutations to you, O my Lord!
metadata.sanskrit_text: वायुर्यमोऽग्निर्वरुणः शशाङ्कः प्रजापतिस्त्वं प्रपितामहश्च। नमो नमस्तेऽस्तु सहस्रकृत्वः पुनश्च भूयोऽपि नमो नमस्ते।।11.39।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Salutations to Thee in front and on all sides, Thou who encompasseth me round about. Thy power is infinite; Thy majesty immeasurable; Thou upholdest all things; indeed, Thou Thyself art All.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Salutations to Thee in front and on all sides, Thou who encompasseth me round about. Thy power is infinite; Thy majesty immeasurable; Thou upholdest all things; indeed, Thou Thyself art All.
metadata.sanskrit_text: नमः पुरस्तादथ पृष्ठतस्ते नमोऽस्तु ते सर्वत एव सर्व। अनन्तवीर्यामितविक्रमस्त्वं सर्वं समाप्नोषि ततोऽसि सर्वः।।11.40।।

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Whatever I have said to you in rashness, taking you only as a friend and addressing you as “O Krishna! O Yadava! O Friend!” in thoughtless familiarity, without understanding your greatness;
metadata.sanskrit_text: सखेति मत्वा प्रसभं यदुक्तं हे कृष्ण हे यादव हे सखेति। अजानता महिमानं तवेदं मया प्रमादात्प्रणयेन वापि।।11.41।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Whatever insults I have offered to You in jest, in sport, in repose, in conversation, or at a banquet, alone or in a crowd, I ask for Your forgiveness for them all, O You Who are without equal!

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Whatever insults I have offered to You in jest, in sport, in repose, in conversation, or at a banquet, alone or in a crowd, I ask for Your forgiveness for them all, O You Who are without equal!
metadata.sanskrit_text: यच्चावहासार्थमसत्कृतोऽसि विहारशय्यासनभोजनेषु। एकोऽथवाप्यच्युत तत्समक्षं तत्क्षामये त्वामहमप्रमेयम्।।11.42।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: For you are the Father of all things movable and immovable, the Worshipful, the Master of Masters! In all the worlds, there is none equal to you; how then could there be one superior, O you who stand alone, Supreme?

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: For you are the Father of all things movable and immovable, the Worshipful, the Master of Masters! In all the worlds, there is none equal to you; how then could there be one superior, O you who stand alone, Supreme?
metadata.sanskrit_text: पितासि लोकस्य चराचरस्य त्वमस्य पूज्यश्च गुरुर्गरीयान्। न त्वत्समोऽस्त्यभ्यधिकः कुतोऽन्यो लोकत्रयेऽप्यप्रतिमप्रभाव।।11.43।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Therefore, I prostrate myself before You, O Lord! Most Adorable! I salute You, and I ask for Your blessing. Only You can be trusted to bear with me, like a father to a son, like a friend to a friend, and like a lover to his beloved.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Therefore, I prostrate myself before You, O Lord! Most Adorable! I salute You, and I ask for Your blessing. Only You can be trusted to bear with me, like a father to a son, like a friend to a friend, and like a lover to his beloved.
metadata.sanskrit_text: तस्मात्प्रणम्य प्रणिधाय कायं प्रसादये त्वामहमीशमीड्यम्। पितेव पुत्रस्य सखेव सख्युः प्रियः प्रियायार्हसि देव सोढुम्।।11.44।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: I rejoice that I have seen what no man has ever seen before; yet, O Lord! I am overwhelmed with fear. Please take on the form I know. Be merciful, O Lord! You who are the home of the entire universe.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: I rejoice that I have seen what no man has ever seen before; yet, O Lord! I am overwhelmed with fear. Please take on the form I know. Be merciful, O Lord! You who are the home of the entire universe.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अदृष्टपूर्वं हृषितोऽस्मि दृष्ट्वा भयेन च प्रव्यथितं मनो मे। तदेव मे दर्शय देव रूपं प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास।।11.45।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: I long to see Thee as Thou wert before, with the crown, the scepter, and the discus in Thy hands; in Thy other form, with Thy four hands, O Thou whose arms are countless and whose forms are infinite.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: I long to see Thee as Thou wert before, with the crown, the scepter, and the discus in Thy hands; in Thy other form, with Thy four hands, O Thou whose arms are countless and whose forms are infinite.
metadata.sanskrit_text: किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रहस्त मिच्छामि त्वां द्रष्टुमहं तथैव। तेनैव रूपेण चतुर्भुजेन सहस्रबाहो भव विश्वमूर्ते।।11.46।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: My beloved friend! It is only through My grace and power that you have been able to see this vision of splendour, the Universal, the Infinite, the Original. Never has it been seen by anyone else.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: My beloved friend! It is only through My grace and power that you have been able to see this vision of splendour, the Universal, the Infinite, the Original. Never has it been seen by anyone else.
metadata.sanskrit_text: श्री भगवानुवाच मया प्रसन्नेन तवार्जुनेदं रूपं परं दर्शितमात्मयोगात्। तेजोमयं विश्वमनन्तमाद्यं यन्मे त्वदन्येन न दृष्टपूर्वम्।।11.47।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: It is not possible for man on earth to see what thou hast seen, O thou foremost hero of the Kuru-clan, through study of the scriptures, sacrifice or gift, ritual or rigorous austerity!

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: It is not possible for man on earth to see what thou hast seen, O thou foremost hero of the Kuru-clan, through study of the scriptures, sacrifice or gift, ritual or rigorous austerity!
metadata.sanskrit_text: न वेदयज्ञाध्ययनैर्न दानै र्न च क्रियाभिर्न तपोभिरुग्रैः। एवंरूपः शक्य अहं नृलोके द्रष्टुं त्वदन्येन कुरुप्रवीर।।11.48।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Do not be afraid or confused by the terrible vision. Put away your fear and, with a joyful mind, see Me again in My usual form.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Do not be afraid or confused by the terrible vision. Put away your fear and, with a joyful mind, see Me again in My usual form.
metadata.sanskrit_text: मा ते व्यथा मा च विमूढभावो दृष्ट्वा रूपं घोरमीदृङ्ममेदम्। व्यपेतभीः प्रीतमनाः पुनस्त्वं तदेव मे रूपमिदं प्रपश्य।।11.49।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Sanjaya continued: "Having thus spoken to Arjuna, Lord Shri Krishna showed Himself again in His accustomed form; and the Mighty Lord, in gentle tones, softly consoled him who had recently trembled with fear.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Sanjaya continued: "Having thus spoken to Arjuna, Lord Shri Krishna showed Himself again in His accustomed form; and the Mighty Lord, in gentle tones, softly consoled him who had recently trembled with fear.
metadata.sanskrit_text: सञ्जय उवाच इत्यर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वा स्वकं रूपं दर्शयामास भूयः। आश्वासयामास च भीतमेनं भूत्वा पुनः सौम्यवपुर्महात्मा।।11.50।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Arjuna said: Seeing You in Your gentle human form, my Lord, I am myself again, calm once more.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Arjuna said: Seeing You in Your gentle human form, my Lord, I am myself again, calm once more.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अर्जुन उवाच दृष्ट्वेदं मानुषं रूपं तवसौम्यं जनार्दन। इदानीमस्मि संवृत्तः सचेताः प्रकृतिं गतः।।11.51।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: It is difficult to see the vision of Me that thou hast seen. Even the most powerful have longed for it in vain.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: It is difficult to see the vision of Me that thou hast seen. Even the most powerful have longed for it in vain.
metadata.sanskrit_text: श्री भगवानुवाच सुदुर्दर्शमिदं रूपं दृष्टवानसि यन्मम। देवा अप्यस्य रूपस्य नित्यं दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः।।11.52।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: It is not possible to see Me as you have done through studying the scriptures, performing austerities, giving gifts, or making sacrifices.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: It is not possible to see Me as you have done through studying the scriptures, performing austerities, giving gifts, or making sacrifices.
metadata.sanskrit_text: नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया। शक्य एवंविधो द्रष्टुं दृष्टवानसि मां यथा।।11.53।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: Only through tireless devotion can I be seen and known; only in this way can a person become one with Me, O Arjuna!

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: Only through tireless devotion can I be seen and known; only in this way can a person become one with Me, O Arjuna!
metadata.sanskrit_text: भक्त्या त्वनन्यया शक्यमहमेवंविधोऽर्जुन। ज्ञातुं दृष्टुं च तत्त्वेन प्रवेष्टुं च परंतप।।11.54।।

document:
Chapter: Vishwaroopa Darshana Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
Translation: He who does every action for My sake, to whom I am the final goal, who loves Me alone and hates no one—O My dearest son, only he can realize Me!

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Beholding the Cosmic Form of God
metadata.english_translation: He who does every action for My sake, to whom I am the final goal, who loves Me alone and hates no one—O My dearest son, only he can realize Me!
metadata.sanskrit_text: मत्कर्मकृन्मत्परमो मद्भक्तः सङ्गवर्जितः। निर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स मामेति पाण्डव।।11.55।।

document:
Chapter: Bhakti Yoga
Meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
Translation: Arjuna asked, "My Lord, which are the better devotees who worship You: those who try to know You as a Personal God, or those who worship You as Impersonal and Indestructible?"

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
metadata.english_translation: Arjuna asked, "My Lord, which are the better devotees who worship You: those who try to know You as a Personal God, or those who worship You as Impersonal and Indestructible?"
metadata.sanskrit_text: अर्जुन उवाचएवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते।येचाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः।।12.1।।

document:
Chapter: Bhakti Yoga
Meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
Translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: Those who keep their minds fixed on Me, who worship Me always with unwavering faith and concentration, are the very best.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
metadata.english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: Those who keep their minds fixed on Me, who worship Me always with unwavering faith and concentration, are the very best.
metadata.sanskrit_text: श्री भगवानुवाचमय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते।श्रद्धया परयोपेतास्ते मे युक्ततमा मताः।।12.2।।

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
metadata.english_translation: Those who worship Me as the Indestructible, the Undefinable, the Omnipresent, the Unthinkable, the Primal, the Immutable, and the Eternal;
metadata.sanskrit_text: ये त्वक्षरमनिर्देश्यमव्यक्तं पर्युपासते।सर्वत्रगमचिन्त्यं च कूटस्थमचलं ध्रुवम्।।12.3।।

document:
Chapter: Bhakti Yoga
Meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
Translation: Subduing their senses, viewing all conditions of life with an equal eye, and working for the welfare of all beings, they assuredly come to Me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
metadata.english_translation: Subduing their senses, viewing all conditions of life with an equal eye, and working for the welfare of all beings, they assuredly come to Me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: संनियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं सर्वत्र समबुद्धयः।ते प्राप्नुवन्ति मामेव सर्वभूतहिते रताः।।12.4।।

document:
Chapter: Bhakti Yoga
Meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
Translation: But they who fix their attention on the Absolute and Impersonal encounter greater hardships, for it is difficult for those who have a body to realize Me as without one.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
metadata.english_translation: But they who fix their attention on the Absolute and Impersonal encounter greater hardships, for it is difficult for those who have a body to realize Me as without one.
metadata.sanskrit_text: क्लेशोऽधिकतरस्तेषामव्यक्तासक्तचेतसाम्। अव्यक्ता हि गतिर्दुःखं देहवद्भिरवाप्यते।।12.5।।

document:
Chapter: Bhakti Yoga
Meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
Translation: Verily, those who surrender their actions to Me, who contemplate Me, worship Me, and meditate on Me alone, with no thought other than Me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
metadata.english_translation: Verily, those who surrender their actions to Me, who contemplate Me, worship Me, and meditate on Me alone, with no thought other than Me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्पराः।अनन्येनैव योगेन मां ध्यायन्त उपासते।।12.6।।

document:
Chapter: Bhakti Yoga
Meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
Translation: O Arjuna! I rescue them from the ocean of life and death, for their minds are fixed upon Me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
metadata.english_translation: O Arjuna! I rescue them from the ocean of life and death, for their minds are fixed upon Me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: तेषामहं समुद्धर्ता मृत्युसंसारसागरात्।भवामि नचिरात्पार्थ मय्यावेशितचेतसाम्।।12.7।।

document:
Chapter: Bhakti Yoga
Meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
Translation: Then let your mind cling only to Me, let your intellect abide in Me; and without doubt, you will live hereafter in Me alone.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
metadata.english_translation: Then let your mind cling only to Me, let your intellect abide in Me; and without doubt, you will live hereafter in Me alone.
metadata.sanskrit_text: मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय।निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत ऊर्ध्वं न संशयः।।12.8।।

document:
Chapter: Bhakti Yoga
Meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
Translation: But if you cannot fix your mind firmly on Me, then, my beloved friend, try to do so through constant practice.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
metadata.english_translation: But if you cannot fix your mind firmly on Me, then, my beloved friend, try to do so through constant practice.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थिरम्।अभ्यासयोगेन ततो मामिच्छाप्तुं धनञ्जय।।12.9।।

document:
Chapter: Bhakti Yoga
Meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
Translation: And if you are not strong enough to practice concentration, then devote yourself to My service, do all your acts for My sake, and you will still attain the goal.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
metadata.english_translation: And if you are not strong enough to practice concentration, then devote yourself to My service, do all your acts for My sake, and you will still attain the goal.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अभ्यासेऽप्यसमर्थोऽसि मत्कर्मपरमो भव।मदर्थमपि कर्माणि कुर्वन् सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि।।12.10।।

document:
Chapter: Bhakti Yoga
Meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
Translation: And if thou art too weak to do even this, then seek refuge in union with Me, and with perfect self-control renounce the fruits of thy actions.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
metadata.english_translation: And if thou art too weak to do even this, then seek refuge in union with Me, and with perfect self-control renounce the fruits of thy actions.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अथैतदप्यशक्तोऽसि कर्तुं मद्योगमाश्रितः।सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं ततः कुरु यतात्मवान्।।12.11।।

document:
Chapter: Bhakti Yoga
Meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
Translation: Knowledge is superior to blind action, meditation is superior to knowledge, renunciation of the fruit of action is superior to meditation, and peace follows from renunciation.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
metadata.english_translation: Knowledge is superior to blind action, meditation is superior to knowledge, renunciation of the fruit of action is superior to meditation, and peace follows from renunciation.
metadata.sanskrit_text: श्रेयो हि ज्ञानमभ्यासाज्ज्ञानाद्ध्यानं विशिष्यते।ध्यानात्कर्मफलत्यागस्त्यागाच्छान्तिरनन्तरम्।।12.12।।

document:
Chapter: Bhakti Yoga
Meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
Translation: He who is incapable of hatred towards any being, who is kind and compassionate, free from selfishness, without pride, equable in pleasure and pain, and forgiving—

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
metadata.english_translation: He who is incapable of hatred towards any being, who is kind and compassionate, free from selfishness, without pride, equable in pleasure and pain, and forgiving—
metadata.sanskrit_text: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च।निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी।।12.13।।

document:
Chapter: Bhakti Yoga
Meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
Translation: Always content, self-centered, self-controlled, resolute, with mind and reason dedicated to Me, such a devotee of Mine is beloved to Me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
metadata.english_translation: Always content, self-centered, self-controlled, resolute, with mind and reason dedicated to Me, such a devotee of Mine is beloved to Me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः।मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः।।12.14।।

document:
Chapter: Bhakti Yoga
Meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
Translation: He who does not harm the world, and whom the world cannot harm, who is not carried away by any impulse of joy, anger, or fear; such a one is My beloved.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
metadata.english_translation: He who does not harm the world, and whom the world cannot harm, who is not carried away by any impulse of joy, anger, or fear; such a one is My beloved.
metadata.sanskrit_text: यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः।हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः।।12.15।।

document:
Chapter: Bhakti Yoga
Meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
Translation: He who expects nothing, is pure, watchful, indifferent, unruffled, and renounces all initiative—such a one is My beloved.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
metadata.english_translation: He who expects nothing, is pure, watchful, indifferent, unruffled, and renounces all initiative—such a one is My beloved.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अनपेक्षः शुचिर्दक्ष उदासीनो गतव्यथः।सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः।।12.16।।

document:
Chapter: Bhakti Yoga
Meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
Translation: He who is beyond joy and hate, who neither laments nor desires, to whom good and evil fortunes are the same, such a one is beloved to Me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
metadata.english_translation: He who is beyond joy and hate, who neither laments nor desires, to whom good and evil fortunes are the same, such a one is beloved to Me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति।शुभाशुभपरित्यागी भक्ितमान्यः स मे प्रियः।।12.17।।

document:
Chapter: Bhakti Yoga
Meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
Translation: He to whom friend and foe are alike, who welcomes equally honor and dishonor, heat and cold, pleasure and pain, and who is enamored of nothing—

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
metadata.english_translation: He to whom friend and foe are alike, who welcomes equally honor and dishonor, heat and cold, pleasure and pain, and who is enamored of nothing—
metadata.sanskrit_text: समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः।शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु समः सङ्गविवर्जितः।।12.18।।

document:
Chapter: Bhakti Yoga
Meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
Translation: Who is indifferent to praise and censure, enjoys silence, is content with every fate, has no fixed abode, is steadfast in mind, and filled with devotion—such a one is My beloved.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
metadata.english_translation: Who is indifferent to praise and censure, enjoys silence, is content with every fate, has no fixed abode, is steadfast in mind, and filled with devotion—such a one is My beloved.
metadata.sanskrit_text: तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी सन्तुष्टो येनकेनचित्।अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्ितमान्मे प्रियो नरः।।12.19।।

document:
Chapter: Bhakti Yoga
Meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
Translation: Verily, those who love the spiritual wisdom as I have taught, whose faith never wavers, and who focus their entire being on Me, they are indeed My most beloved.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: The Yoga of Devotion
metadata.english_translation: Verily, those who love the spiritual wisdom as I have taught, whose faith never wavers, and who focus their entire being on Me, they are indeed My most beloved.
metadata.sanskrit_text: ये तु धर्म्यामृतमिदं यथोक्तं पर्युपासते।श्रद्दधाना मत्परमा भक्तास्तेऽतीव मे प्रियाः।।12.20।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: Arjuna asked, "My Lord, who is God, what is Nature, what is Matter, and what is the Self? What is Wisdom, and what is worth knowing? I wish to have this explained."

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: Arjuna asked, "My Lord, who is God, what is Nature, what is Matter, and what is the Self? What is Wisdom, and what is worth knowing? I wish to have this explained."
metadata.sanskrit_text: अर्जुन उवाच प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रज्ञमेव च। एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामि ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं च केशव।।13.1।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: O Arjuna! The body of a person is the playground of the Self; and That which knows the activities of Matter, sages call the Self.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: O Arjuna! The body of a person is the playground of the Self; and That which knows the activities of Matter, sages call the Self.
metadata.sanskrit_text: श्री भगवानुवाचइदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते।एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः।।13.2।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: I am the omniscient Self that abides in the realm of matter; knowledge of matter and of the all-knowing Self is wisdom.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: I am the omniscient Self that abides in the realm of matter; knowledge of matter and of the all-knowing Self is wisdom.
metadata.sanskrit_text: क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत। क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत्तज्ज्ञानं मतं मम।।13.3।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: What is called Matter, of what it is composed, whence it came, and why it changes, what the Self is, and what its power - this I will now briefly set forth.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: What is called Matter, of what it is composed, whence it came, and why it changes, what the Self is, and what its power - this I will now briefly set forth.
metadata.sanskrit_text: तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक् च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत्।स च यो यत्प्रभावश्च तत्समासेन मे श्रृणु।।13.4।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: Seers have sung of it in various ways, in many hymns and sacred Vedic songs, weighty in thought and convincing in their arguments.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: Seers have sung of it in various ways, in many hymns and sacred Vedic songs, weighty in thought and convincing in their arguments.
metadata.sanskrit_text: ऋषिभिर्बहुधा गीतं छन्दोभिर्विविधैः पृथक्।ब्रह्मसूत्रपदैश्चैव हेतुमद्भिर्विनिश्िचतैः।।13.5।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: The five great fundamentals—earth, fire, air, water, and ether—personality, intellect, the mysterious life force, the ten organs of perception and action, the mind, and the five domains of sensation—

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: The five great fundamentals—earth, fire, air, water, and ether—personality, intellect, the mysterious life force, the ten organs of perception and action, the mind, and the five domains of sensation—
metadata.sanskrit_text: महाभूतान्यहङ्कारो बुद्धिरव्यक्तमेव च।इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च पञ्च चेन्द्रियगोचराः।।13.6।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: Desire, aversion, pleasure, pain, sympathy, vitality, and the persistent clinging to life—these are, in brief, the constituents of changing matter.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: Desire, aversion, pleasure, pain, sympathy, vitality, and the persistent clinging to life—these are, in brief, the constituents of changing matter.
metadata.sanskrit_text: इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं सङ्घातश्चेतनाधृतिः।एतत्क्षेत्रं समासेन सविकारमुदाहृतम्।।13.7।।

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: Humility, sincerity, harmlessness, forgiveness, rectitude, service to the Master, purity, steadfastness, and self-control;
metadata.sanskrit_text: अमानित्वमदम्भित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम्।आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः।।13.8।।

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: Renouncing the delights of the senses, being without pride, having a right understanding of the painful problem of birth and death, and of age and sickness;
metadata.sanskrit_text: इन्द्रियार्थेषु वैराग्यमनहङ्कार एव च।जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिदुःखदोषानुदर्शनम्।।13.9।।

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: Indifference, non-attachment to sex, progeny, or home, equanimity in both good fortune and bad;
metadata.sanskrit_text: असक्ितरनभिष्वङ्गः पुत्रदारगृहादिषु।नित्यं च समचित्तत्वमिष्टानिष्टोपपत्तिषु।।13.10।।

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: Unswerving devotion to Me, with concentration on Me and Me alone, a love for solitude, and indifference to social life;
metadata.sanskrit_text: मयि चानन्ययोगेन भक्ितरव्यभिचारिणी।विविक्तदेशसेवित्वमरतिर्जनसंसदि।।13.11।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: Constant yearning for the knowledge of the Self, and pondering over the lessons of the great Truth—this is wisdom; all else is ignorance.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: Constant yearning for the knowledge of the Self, and pondering over the lessons of the great Truth—this is wisdom; all else is ignorance.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अध्यात्मज्ञाननित्यत्वं तत्त्वज्ञानार्थदर्शनम्।एतज्ज्ञानमिति प्रोक्तमज्ञानं यदतोन्यथा।।13.12।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: I will now speak to you of that great truth which one ought to know, since by it one will attain immortal bliss—that which is without beginning, the eternal spirit which dwells in me, neither with form nor without it.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: I will now speak to you of that great truth which one ought to know, since by it one will attain immortal bliss—that which is without beginning, the eternal spirit which dwells in me, neither with form nor without it.
metadata.sanskrit_text: ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वाऽमृतमश्नुते।अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते।।13.13।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: Everywhere are Its hands and feet; everywhere It has eyes that see, heads that think, and mouths that speak; everywhere It listens; It dwells in all the worlds and envelops them all.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: Everywhere are Its hands and feet; everywhere It has eyes that see, heads that think, and mouths that speak; everywhere It listens; It dwells in all the worlds and envelops them all.
metadata.sanskrit_text: सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम्।सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति।।13.14।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: Beyond the senses, it yet shines through every sense perception; bound to nothing, it yet sustains everything; unaffected by the qualities, it still enjoys them all.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: Beyond the senses, it yet shines through every sense perception; bound to nothing, it yet sustains everything; unaffected by the qualities, it still enjoys them all.
metadata.sanskrit_text: सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम्।असक्तं सर्वभृच्चैव निर्गुणं गुणभोक्तृ च।।13.15।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: It is within all beings, yet outside; motionless yet moving; too subtle to be perceived; far away yet ever near.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: It is within all beings, yet outside; motionless yet moving; too subtle to be perceived; far away yet ever near.
metadata.sanskrit_text: बहिरन्तश्च भूतानामचरं चरमेव च।सूक्ष्मत्वात्तदविज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च तत्।।13.16।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: In all beings, undivided yet living in division, it is the upholder of all, both creator and destroyer alike.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: In all beings, undivided yet living in division, it is the upholder of all, both creator and destroyer alike.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम्।भूतभर्तृ च तज्ज्ञेयं ग्रसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु च।।13.17।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: It is the light of lights, beyond the reach of darkness; the wisdom, the only thing worth knowing or that wisdom can teach; the presence in the hearts of all.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: It is the light of lights, beyond the reach of darkness; the wisdom, the only thing worth knowing or that wisdom can teach; the presence in the hearts of all.
metadata.sanskrit_text: ज्योतिषामपि तज्ज्योतिस्तमसः परमुच्यते।ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य विष्ठितम्।।13.18।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: Thus, I have briefly told you what Matter is, the Self worth realizing, and what Wisdom is. He who is devoted to Me knows, and he will assuredly enter into Me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: Thus, I have briefly told you what Matter is, the Self worth realizing, and what Wisdom is. He who is devoted to Me knows, and he will assuredly enter into Me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः।मद्भक्त एतद्विज्ञाय मद्भावायोपपद्यते।।13.19।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: Know further that Nature and God have no beginning, and that differences in character and quality originate from Nature only.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: Know further that Nature and God have no beginning, and that differences in character and quality originate from Nature only.
metadata.sanskrit_text: प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव विद्ध्यनादी उभावपि।विकारांश्च गुणांश्चैव विद्धि प्रकृतिसंभवान्।।13.20।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: Nature is the law that generates cause and effect; God is the source of all pleasure and pain.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: Nature is the law that generates cause and effect; God is the source of all pleasure and pain.
metadata.sanskrit_text: कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिरुच्यते।पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यते।।13.21।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: God, dwelling in the heart of Nature, experiences the qualities that Nature brings forth; and His affinity towards these qualities is the reason for His living in a good or evil body.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: God, dwelling in the heart of Nature, experiences the qualities that Nature brings forth; and His affinity towards these qualities is the reason for His living in a good or evil body.
metadata.sanskrit_text: पुरुषः प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुङ्क्ते प्रकृतिजान्गुणान्।कारणं गुणसङ्गोऽस्य सदसद्योनिजन्मसु।।13.22।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: Thus, in the body of man dwells the Supreme God; He who sees, permits, upholds, and enjoys is the Highest God and the Highest Self.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: Thus, in the body of man dwells the Supreme God; He who sees, permits, upholds, and enjoys is the Highest God and the Highest Self.
metadata.sanskrit_text: उपद्रष्टाऽनुमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वरः।परमात्मेति चाप्युक्तो देहेऽस्मिन्पुरुषः परः।।13.23।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: He who understands God and Nature, along with her qualities, whatever his condition in life may be, will not come back to earth.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: He who understands God and Nature, along with her qualities, whatever his condition in life may be, will not come back to earth.
metadata.sanskrit_text: य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणैःसह।सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि न स भूयोऽभिजायते।।13.24।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: Some realize the Supreme by meditating, with its aid, on the Self within; others by pure reason; and still others by right action.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: Some realize the Supreme by meditating, with its aid, on the Self within; others by pure reason; and still others by right action.
metadata.sanskrit_text: ध्यानेनात्मनि पश्यन्ति केचिदात्मानमात्मना।अन्ये सांख्येन योगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे।।13.25।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: Others, again, having no direct knowledge but only hearing from others, still worship, and, if they are true to the teachings, they too will cross the sea of death.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: Others, again, having no direct knowledge but only hearing from others, still worship, and, if they are true to the teachings, they too will cross the sea of death.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अन्ये त्वेवमजानन्तः श्रुत्वाऽन्येभ्य उपासते।तेऽपि चातितरन्त्येव मृत्युं श्रुतिपरायणाः।।13.26।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: Wherever life is seen in things movable or immovable, it is the result of the combination of Matter and Spirit.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: Wherever life is seen in things movable or immovable, it is the result of the combination of Matter and Spirit.
metadata.sanskrit_text: यावत्सञ्जायते किञ्चित्सत्त्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम्।क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञसंयोगात्तद्विद्धि भरतर्षभ।।13.27।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: He who can see the Supreme Lord in all beings, the Imperishable amidst the perishable, he is the one who truly sees.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: He who can see the Supreme Lord in all beings, the Imperishable amidst the perishable, he is the one who truly sees.
metadata.sanskrit_text: समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम्।विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति।।13.28।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: Beholding the Lord equally in all things, his actions do not mar his spiritual life but lead him to the heights of bliss.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: Beholding the Lord equally in all things, his actions do not mar his spiritual life but lead him to the heights of bliss.
metadata.sanskrit_text: समं पश्यन्हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम्।न हिनस्त्यात्मनाऽऽत्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम्।।13.29।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: He who understands that it is only the Law of Nature that brings action to fruition, and that the Self never acts, alone knows the Truth.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: He who understands that it is only the Law of Nature that brings action to fruition, and that the Self never acts, alone knows the Truth.
metadata.sanskrit_text: प्रकृत्यैव च कर्माणि क्रियमाणानि सर्वशः।यः पश्यति तथाऽऽत्मानमकर्तारं स पश्यति।।13.30।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: He who sees the diverse forms of life all rooted in One and growing forth from Him, shall indeed find the Absolute.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: He who sees the diverse forms of life all rooted in One and growing forth from Him, shall indeed find the Absolute.
metadata.sanskrit_text: यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति।तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा।।13.31।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: The Supreme Spirit, O Prince, is without beginning, has no qualities, and is imperishable. Though it is within the body, it does not act, nor is it affected by action.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: The Supreme Spirit, O Prince, is without beginning, has no qualities, and is imperishable. Though it is within the body, it does not act, nor is it affected by action.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अनादित्वान्निर्गुणत्वात्परमात्मायमव्ययः।शरीरस्थोऽपि कौन्तेय न करोति न लिप्यते।।13.32।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: As space, though present everywhere, remains unaffected due to its subtlety, so too the Self, though present in all forms, retains its purity unalloyed.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: As space, though present everywhere, remains unaffected due to its subtlety, so too the Self, though present in all forms, retains its purity unalloyed.
metadata.sanskrit_text: यथा सर्वगतं सौक्ष्म्यादाकाशं नोपलिप्यते।सर्वत्रावस्थितो देहे तथाऽऽत्मा नोपलिप्यते।।13.33।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: As the one Sun illuminates the entire earth, so the Lord illuminates the entire universe.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: As the one Sun illuminates the entire earth, so the Lord illuminates the entire universe.
metadata.sanskrit_text: यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः।क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत।।13.34।।

document:
Chapter: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
Translation: Those who, with the eyes of wisdom, thus see the difference between Matter and Spirit, and know how to liberate life from the Law of Nature, attain the Supreme.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Distinguishing the Field and the Knower of the Field
metadata.english_translation: Those who, with the eyes of wisdom, thus see the difference between Matter and Spirit, and know how to liberate life from the Law of Nature, attain the Supreme.
metadata.sanskrit_text: क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेवमन्तरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा।भूतप्रकृतिमोक्षं च ये विदुर्यान्ति ते परम्।।13.35।।

document:
Chapter: Gunatraya Vibhaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
Translation: Lord Shri Krishna continued: Now I will reveal to you the wisdom that is beyond knowledge, by attaining which the sages have reached perfection.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
metadata.english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna continued: Now I will reveal to you the wisdom that is beyond knowledge, by attaining which the sages have reached perfection.
metadata.sanskrit_text: श्री भगवानुवाचपरं भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम्।यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिमितो गताः।।14.1।।

document:
Chapter: Gunatraya Vibhaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
Translation: Dwelling in wisdom and realizing My divinity, they are not reborn when the universe is recreated at the beginning of every cycle, nor are they affected when it is dissolved.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
metadata.english_translation: Dwelling in wisdom and realizing My divinity, they are not reborn when the universe is recreated at the beginning of every cycle, nor are they affected when it is dissolved.
metadata.sanskrit_text: इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः।सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च।।14.2।।

document:
Chapter: Gunatraya Vibhaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
Translation: The eternal cosmos is My womb, in which I plant the seed from which all beings are born, O prince!

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
metadata.english_translation: The eternal cosmos is My womb, in which I plant the seed from which all beings are born, O prince!
metadata.sanskrit_text: मम योनिर्महद्ब्रह्म तस्मिन् गर्भं दधाम्यहम्।संभवः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति भारत।।14.3।।

document:
Chapter: Gunatraya Vibhaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
Translation: O illustrious son of Kunti! Through whatever wombs men are born, it is the Spirit itself that conceives, and I am their father.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
metadata.english_translation: O illustrious son of Kunti! Through whatever wombs men are born, it is the Spirit itself that conceives, and I am their father.
metadata.sanskrit_text: सर्वयोनिषु कौन्तेय मूर्तयः सम्भवन्ति याः।तासां ब्रह्म महद्योनिरहं बीजप्रदः पिता।।14.4।।

document:
Chapter: Gunatraya Vibhaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
Translation: Purity, passion, and ignorance are the qualities that the law of nature brings forth. They fetter the free spirit in all beings.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
metadata.english_translation: Purity, passion, and ignorance are the qualities that the law of nature brings forth. They fetter the free spirit in all beings.
metadata.sanskrit_text: सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसंभवाः।निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम्।।14.5।।

document:
Chapter: Gunatraya Vibhaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
Translation: O Sinless One! Of these, purity, being luminous, strong, and invulnerable, binds one with its yearning for happiness and illumination.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
metadata.english_translation: O Sinless One! Of these, purity, being luminous, strong, and invulnerable, binds one with its yearning for happiness and illumination.
metadata.sanskrit_text: तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम्।सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ।।14.6।।

document:
Chapter: Gunatraya Vibhaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
Translation: Passion, engendered by thirst for pleasure and attachment, binds the soul through its fondness for activities.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
metadata.english_translation: Passion, engendered by thirst for pleasure and attachment, binds the soul through its fondness for activities.
metadata.sanskrit_text: रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम्।तन्निबध्नाति कौन्तेय कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम्।।14.7।।

document:
Chapter: Gunatraya Vibhaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
Translation: But Ignorance, the product of darkness, stupefies the senses of all embodied beings, binding them with chains of folly, indolence, and lethargy.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
metadata.english_translation: But Ignorance, the product of darkness, stupefies the senses of all embodied beings, binding them with chains of folly, indolence, and lethargy.
metadata.sanskrit_text: तमस्त्वज्ञानजं विद्धि मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम्।प्रमादालस्यनिद्राभिस्तन्निबध्नाति भारत।।14.8।।

document:
Chapter: Gunatraya Vibhaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
Translation: Purity brings happiness, passion brings commotion, and ignorance, which obscures wisdom, leads to a life of failure.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
metadata.english_translation: Purity brings happiness, passion brings commotion, and ignorance, which obscures wisdom, leads to a life of failure.
metadata.sanskrit_text: सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत।ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे सञ्जयत्युत।।14.9।।

document:
Chapter: Gunatraya Vibhaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
Translation: O Prince! Purity prevails when passion and ignorance are overcome; passion, when purity and ignorance are overcome; and ignorance when it is overcome by purity and passion.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
metadata.english_translation: O Prince! Purity prevails when passion and ignorance are overcome; passion, when purity and ignorance are overcome; and ignorance when it is overcome by purity and passion.
metadata.sanskrit_text: रजस्तमश्चाभिभूय सत्त्वं भवति भारत।रजः सत्त्वं तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा।।14.10।।

document:
Chapter: Gunatraya Vibhaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
Translation: When the light of knowledge gleams forth from all the gates of the body, then be sure that purity prevails.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
metadata.english_translation: When the light of knowledge gleams forth from all the gates of the body, then be sure that purity prevails.
metadata.sanskrit_text: सर्वद्वारेषु देहेऽस्मिन्प्रकाश उपजायते।ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्याद्विवृद्धं सत्त्वमित्युत।।14.11।।

document:
Chapter: Gunatraya Vibhaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
Translation: O best of Indians! Avarice, the impulse to act, and the beginning of action itself are all due to the dominance of passion.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
metadata.english_translation: O best of Indians! Avarice, the impulse to act, and the beginning of action itself are all due to the dominance of passion.
metadata.sanskrit_text: लोभः प्रवृत्तिरारम्भः कर्मणामशमः स्पृहा।रजस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे भरतर्षभ।।14.12।।

document:
Chapter: Gunatraya Vibhaga Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through Understanding the Three Modes of Material Nature
