metadata.sanskrit_text: विषयेन्द्रियसंयोगाद्यत्तदग्रेऽमृतोपमम्।परिणामे विषमिव तत्सुखं राजसं स्मृतम्।।18.38।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: While the pleasure that drugs the senses from start to finish, which springs from indolence, lethargy, and folly—that pleasure flows from Ignorance.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: While the pleasure that drugs the senses from start to finish, which springs from indolence, lethargy, and folly—that pleasure flows from Ignorance.
metadata.sanskrit_text: यदग्रे चानुबन्धे च सुखं मोहनमात्मनः।निद्रालस्यप्रमादोत्थं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्।।18.39।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: There is nothing anywhere on earth or in the higher worlds that is free from the three Qualities, for they are born of Nature.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: There is nothing anywhere on earth or in the higher worlds that is free from the three Qualities, for they are born of Nature.
metadata.sanskrit_text: न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः।सत्त्वं प्रकृतिजैर्मुक्तं यदेभिः स्यात्ित्रभिर्गुणैः।।18.40।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: O Arjuna! The duties of spiritual teachers, the soldiers, the traders, and the servants have all been fixed according to the dominant quality in their nature.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: O Arjuna! The duties of spiritual teachers, the soldiers, the traders, and the servants have all been fixed according to the dominant quality in their nature.
metadata.sanskrit_text: ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परंतप।कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्वभावप्रभवैर्गुणैः।।18.41।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: Serenity, self-restraint, austerity, purity, forgiveness, uprightness, knowledge, wisdom, and faith in God—these constitute the duty of a spiritual teacher.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: Serenity, self-restraint, austerity, purity, forgiveness, uprightness, knowledge, wisdom, and faith in God—these constitute the duty of a spiritual teacher.
metadata.sanskrit_text: शमो दमस्तपः शौचं क्षान्तिरार्जवमेव च।ज्ञानं विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं ब्रह्मकर्म स्वभावजम्।।18.42।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: Valor, glory, firmness, skill, generosity, steadiness in battle, and the ability to rule—these constitute the duty of a soldier. They flow from his own nature.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: Valor, glory, firmness, skill, generosity, steadiness in battle, and the ability to rule—these constitute the duty of a soldier. They flow from his own nature.
metadata.sanskrit_text: शौर्यं तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्यपलायनम्।दानमीश्वरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्वभावजम्।।18.43।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: Agriculture, the protection of cows, and trade are the duties of a trader, in accordance with his nature. The duty of a servant is to serve, which also agrees with his nature.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: Agriculture, the protection of cows, and trade are the duties of a trader, in accordance with his nature. The duty of a servant is to serve, which also agrees with his nature.
metadata.sanskrit_text: कृषिगौरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैश्यकर्म स्वभावजम्।परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि स्वभावजम्।।18.44।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: Perfection is attained when one diligently attends to their duty. Listen, and I will tell you how it is attained by one who always minds their own duty.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: Perfection is attained when one diligently attends to their duty. Listen, and I will tell you how it is attained by one who always minds their own duty.
metadata.sanskrit_text: स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः।स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धिं यथा विन्दति तच्छृणु।।18.45।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: One reaches perfection by dedicating their actions to God, Who is the source of all being and fills everything.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: One reaches perfection by dedicating their actions to God, Who is the source of all being and fills everything.
metadata.sanskrit_text: यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम्।स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः।।18.46।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: It is better to do one's own duty, however defective it may be, than to follow the duty of another, however well one may perform it. He who does his duty as his own nature reveals it, never commits a sin.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: It is better to do one's own duty, however defective it may be, than to follow the duty of another, however well one may perform it. He who does his duty as his own nature reveals it, never commits a sin.
metadata.sanskrit_text: श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्।स्वभावनियतं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम्।।18.47।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: The duty that falls to one's lot of its own accord should not be abandoned, though it may have its defects. All acts are marred by defects, just as fire is obscured by smoke.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: The duty that falls to one's lot of its own accord should not be abandoned, though it may have its defects. All acts are marred by defects, just as fire is obscured by smoke.
metadata.sanskrit_text: सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत्।सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवावृताः।।18.48।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: He whose mind is entirely detached, who has conquered himself, and whose desires have vanished, reaches that stage of perfect freedom through his renunciation, where action completes itself and leaves no seed.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: He whose mind is entirely detached, who has conquered himself, and whose desires have vanished, reaches that stage of perfect freedom through his renunciation, where action completes itself and leaves no seed.
metadata.sanskrit_text: असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः।नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धिं परमां संन्यासेनाधिगच्छति।।18.49।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: I will now state briefly how one who has reached perfection finds the Eternal Spirit, the state of Supreme Wisdom.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: I will now state briefly how one who has reached perfection finds the Eternal Spirit, the state of Supreme Wisdom.
metadata.sanskrit_text: सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे।समासेनैव कौन्तेय निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य या परा।।18.50।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: Guided always by pure reason, bravely restraining himself, renouncing the objects of sense and giving up attachment and hatred; he attains peace.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: Guided always by pure reason, bravely restraining himself, renouncing the objects of sense and giving up attachment and hatred; he attains peace.
metadata.sanskrit_text: बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्याऽऽत्मानं नियम्य च।शब्दादीन् विषयांस्त्यक्त्वा रागद्वेषौ व्युदस्य च।।18.51।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: Enjoying solitude, being abstemious, having his body, mind, and speech under perfect control, and being absorbed in meditation, he becomes free—always filled with the spirit of renunciation.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: Enjoying solitude, being abstemious, having his body, mind, and speech under perfect control, and being absorbed in meditation, he becomes free—always filled with the spirit of renunciation.
metadata.sanskrit_text: विविक्तसेवी लघ्वाशी यतवाक्कायमानसः।ध्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः।।18.52।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: Having abandoned selfishness, power, arrogance, anger, and desire, possessing nothing of his own, and having attained peace, he is fit to join the Eternal Spirit.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: Having abandoned selfishness, power, arrogance, anger, and desire, possessing nothing of his own, and having attained peace, he is fit to join the Eternal Spirit.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम्।विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते।।18.53।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: When he unites with the Eternal and his soul knows the bliss of the Self, he feels no desire or regret, he regards all beings equally, and enjoys the blessing of supreme devotion to Me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: When he unites with the Eternal and his soul knows the bliss of the Self, he feels no desire or regret, he regards all beings equally, and enjoys the blessing of supreme devotion to Me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति।समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पराम्।।18.54।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: By such devotion, he sees Me, who I am and what I am; and thus realizing the truth, he enters into My kingdom.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: By such devotion, he sees Me, who I am and what I am; and thus realizing the truth, he enters into My kingdom.
metadata.sanskrit_text: भक्त्या मामभिजानाति यावान्यश्चास्मि तत्त्वतः।ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम्।।18.55।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: Relying on Me in all his actions and doing them for My sake, he attains, by My grace, eternal and unchangeable life.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: Relying on Me in all his actions and doing them for My sake, he attains, by My grace, eternal and unchangeable life.
metadata.sanskrit_text: सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्व्यपाश्रयः।मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम्।।18.56।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: Surrender your actions to Me, live in Me, focus your intellect on Me, and always think of Me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: Surrender your actions to Me, live in Me, focus your intellect on Me, and always think of Me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः।बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव।।18.57।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: Fix your mind on Me, and by My grace you will overcome the obstacles in your path. But if, misled by pride, you do not listen, then you will indeed be lost.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: Fix your mind on Me, and by My grace you will overcome the obstacles in your path. But if, misled by pride, you do not listen, then you will indeed be lost.
metadata.sanskrit_text: मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात्तरिष्यसि।अथ चेत्त्वमहङ्कारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनङ्क्ष्यसि।।18.58।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: If you in your vanity think of avoiding this fight, your will shall not be fulfilled, for Nature herself will compel you.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: If you in your vanity think of avoiding this fight, your will shall not be fulfilled, for Nature herself will compel you.
metadata.sanskrit_text: यदहङ्कारमाश्रित्य न योत्स्य इति मन्यसे।मिथ्यैष व्यवसायस्ते प्रकृतिस्त्वां नियोक्ष्यति।।18.59।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: O Arjuna! Your duty binds you. It has arisen from your own nature, and that which you do not desire to do in your delusion, you will do that very thing. You are helpless.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: O Arjuna! Your duty binds you. It has arisen from your own nature, and that which you do not desire to do in your delusion, you will do that very thing. You are helpless.
metadata.sanskrit_text: स्वभावजेन कौन्तेय निबद्धः स्वेन कर्मणा।कर्तुं नेच्छसि यन्मोहात्करिष्यस्यवशोऽपि तत्।।18.60।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: God dwells in the hearts of all beings, O Arjuna! He causes them to revolve, as it were, on a wheel, by His mystic power.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: God dwells in the hearts of all beings, O Arjuna! He causes them to revolve, as it were, on a wheel, by His mystic power.
metadata.sanskrit_text: ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां हृद्देशेऽर्जुन तिष्ठति।भ्रामयन्सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूढानि मायया।।18.61।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: With all your strength, fly to Him and surrender yourself, and by His grace you will attain Supreme Peace and reach the Eternal Home.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: With all your strength, fly to Him and surrender yourself, and by His grace you will attain Supreme Peace and reach the Eternal Home.
metadata.sanskrit_text: तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत।तत्प्रसादात्परां शान्तिं स्थानं प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम्।।18.62।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: Thus, I have revealed to you the truth, the mystery of mysteries. Having thought it over, you are free to act as you wish.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: Thus, I have revealed to you the truth, the mystery of mysteries. Having thought it over, you are free to act as you wish.
metadata.sanskrit_text: इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया।विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु।।18.63।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: Listen to My last word once more, the deepest secret of all; you are My beloved, you are My friend, and I speak for your welfare.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: Listen to My last word once more, the deepest secret of all; you are My beloved, you are My friend, and I speak for your welfare.
metadata.sanskrit_text: सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः श्रृणु मे परमं वचः।इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम्।।18.64।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: Dedicate yourself to Me, worship Me, sacrifice all for Me, prostrate yourself before Me, and you will surely come to Me. I truly pledge to you; you are My beloved.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: Dedicate yourself to Me, worship Me, sacrifice all for Me, prostrate yourself before Me, and you will surely come to Me. I truly pledge to you; you are My beloved.
metadata.sanskrit_text: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु।मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे।।18.65।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: Give up your earthly duties, surrender yourself to Me alone. Do not be anxious; I will absolve you from all your sins.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: Give up your earthly duties, surrender yourself to Me alone. Do not be anxious; I will absolve you from all your sins.
metadata.sanskrit_text: सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज।अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः।।18.66।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: Do not speak this to one who has not practiced austerities, or to one who does not love, or who will not listen, or who mocks.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: Do not speak this to one who has not practiced austerities, or to one who does not love, or who will not listen, or who mocks.
metadata.sanskrit_text: इदं ते नातपस्काय नाभक्ताय कदाचन।न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति।।18.67।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: But he who teaches this great secret to My devotees, his is the highest devotion, and he shall surely come to Me.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: But he who teaches this great secret to My devotees, his is the highest devotion, and he shall surely come to Me.
metadata.sanskrit_text: य इमं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति।भक्ितं मयि परां कृत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः।।18.68।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: There is no one among men who can perform a service dearer to Me than this, nor is there any man on earth more beloved by Me than him.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: There is no one among men who can perform a service dearer to Me than this, nor is there any man on earth more beloved by Me than him.
metadata.sanskrit_text: न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्िचन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः।भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि।।18.69।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: He who will study this spiritual discourse of ours, I assure you, they shall thereby worship Me at the altar of Wisdom.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: He who will study this spiritual discourse of ours, I assure you, they shall thereby worship Me at the altar of Wisdom.
metadata.sanskrit_text: अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः।ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः।।18.70।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: Yes, he who listens to it with faith and without doubt, even he, freed from evil, will rise to the worlds which the virtuous attain through righteous deeds.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: Yes, he who listens to it with faith and without doubt, even he, freed from evil, will rise to the worlds which the virtuous attain through righteous deeds.
metadata.sanskrit_text: श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च श्रृणुयादपि यो नरः।सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम्।।18.71।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: O Arjuna, have you listened attentively to My words? Has your ignorance and delusion gone?

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: O Arjuna, have you listened attentively to My words? Has your ignorance and delusion gone?
metadata.sanskrit_text: कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा।कच्चिदज्ञानसंमोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनञ्जय।।18.72।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: Arjuna replied: "My Lord! O Immutable One! My delusion has fled. By Your Grace, O Changeless One, the light has dawned. My doubts have been dispelled, and I stand before You ready to do Your will."

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: Arjuna replied: "My Lord! O Immutable One! My delusion has fled. By Your Grace, O Changeless One, the light has dawned. My doubts have been dispelled, and I stand before You ready to do Your will."
metadata.sanskrit_text: अर्जुन उवाचनष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत।स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव।।18.73।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: Sanjaya said: "I heard this rare, wonderful, and soul-stirring discourse between Lord Shri Krishna and the great-souled Arjuna.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: Sanjaya said: "I heard this rare, wonderful, and soul-stirring discourse between Lord Shri Krishna and the great-souled Arjuna.
metadata.sanskrit_text: सञ्जय उवाचइत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः।संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम्।।18.74।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: Through the blessing of the sage Vyasa, I heard this secret and noble science from the lips of its Master, Lord Shri Krishna.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: Through the blessing of the sage Vyasa, I heard this secret and noble science from the lips of its Master, Lord Shri Krishna.
metadata.sanskrit_text: व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतवानेतद्गुह्यमहं परम्।योगं योगेश्वरात्कृष्णात्साक्षात्कथयतः स्वयम्।।18.75।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: O King! The more I think of that marvelous and holy discourse, the more I lose myself in joy.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: O King! The more I think of that marvelous and holy discourse, the more I lose myself in joy.
metadata.sanskrit_text: राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम्।केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः।।18.76।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: As I recall again and again the exceeding beauty of the Lord, I am filled with amazement and joy.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: As I recall again and again the exceeding beauty of the Lord, I am filled with amazement and joy.
metadata.sanskrit_text: तच्च संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपमत्यद्भुतं हरेः। विस्मयो मे महान् राजन् हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः।।18.77।।

document:
Chapter: Moksha Sanyaas Yoga
Meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
Translation: Wherever Lord Shri Krishna, the Prince of Wisdom, and Arjuna, the Great Archer, are, I am certain that good fortune, victory, happiness, and righteousness will follow.

metadata.chapter_title_meaning: Yoga through the Perfection of Renunciation and Surrender
metadata.english_translation: Wherever Lord Shri Krishna, the Prince of Wisdom, and Arjuna, the Great Archer, are, I am certain that good fortune, victory, happiness, and righteousness will follow.
metadata.sanskrit_text: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः। तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम।।18.78।
